articleTitle: Analysis and Optimization of Gas Field Substation Relay Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The gas industry plays an important role in the country's economy. The main equipment used for gas production was installed in the 1960s and 70s, and over time has reached the final stage of its operation [9], [11], [12]. Aging equipment increases the risk of accidents, which is especially critical for enterprises operating in continuous production mode. The reliability and safety of such enterprises directly depend on the condition of their equipment. In these conditions, the issue of updating and modernizing technical means becomes urgent in order to prevent possible negative consequences for the entire industry. This article analyzes the existing relay protection system of a gas field substation in order to identify its shortcomings and possible vulnerabilities. This will allow us to determine specific measures and recommendations for optimizing its operation, as well as increasing its reliability and efficiency [7], [13], [14].

articleTitle: Verification of the Operational Performance of AFDDs Under Ground Fault Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The sequential arc discharge occurs as a result of damage to the conductive conductor (often referred to as “poor contact”). This type of discharge is particularly difficult to detect, posing a significant hazard. During a sequential arc discharge, the current flowing in the circuit decreases, and a conventional circuit breaker will not activate in response to this reduction in current. In contrast, parallel arc discharges, such as “phase-neutral” and “phase-ground,” are accompanied by an increase in circuit current. The time to ignition can be so short that it may not be sufficient for a standard protective device to disconnect the damaged section of the circuit. To eliminate fires caused by arc discharges, a specialized protection device for arc discharges and spark gaps has been developed and successfully implemented. This article presents a laboratory test bench designed to evaluate the performance of protection devices against parallel arc discharges and spark gaps under ground fault conditions. This test bench allows for the assessment of devices' responsiveness during ground faults, with the potential for subsequent certification. The conducted tests demonstrate the necessity of establishing mandatory requirements for these devices to standardize their operational algorithms. It has been determined that the protection device can effectively disconnect parallel arc discharges to ground, thereby enhancing the safety of electrical networks up to 0.4 kV and reducing the incidence of fires caused by violations of electrical equipment installation and operation standards.

articleTitle: Optimal Management of a Multi-Energy Microgrid Community Based on Building-to-Grid Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Building-to-Grid (B2G) technology is an innovative approach that integrates buildings considered as multi-energy microgrids (MEMs) into the electrical grid, making them not only consumers, but also active participants in managing energy consumption and electricity generation. The paper proposes a model of an intelligent system “autonomous dispatcher” of an urban MEM community within the framework of the B2G concept. The structure of such a model implements learning agents based on multi-agent reinforcement learning methodology to achieve the goals of both the distribution network and the buildings connected to it within a single energy community. The proposed model relies on a multi-agent version of the PPO method to manage building demand and regulate voltage in the distribution network. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated by the example of a real urban power district, including various types of buildings with climate control systems and distributed energy generation facilities.

articleTitle: Direct and Indirect Measurements of Force and Torque in Wire Drawing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article describes three experimental methods for determining the drawing force - strain gauge, indirect using electrical value sensors installed as part of an electric drive and non-contact by measuring wire vibrations and converting the obtained frequencies into an electrical signal. The strain gauge method for determining the drawing force is the most accurate, since the measurement is carried out directly, i.e. it allows measuring the force of the die pressure on the strain gauge directly. Calibration of the strain gauge with a weighing converter carried out on a verified electromechanical or hydraulic tensile testing machine guarantees high measurement accuracy. The indirect method for measuring the drawing force using electrical value sensors installed as part of an electric drive is less accurate, but its significant advantage is the ability to carry out measurements in industrial conditions without making significant design changes to the drawing machine. The contactless method for determining the drawing force by means of a device reading wire vibrations and converting them into an electrical signal can be used on virtually any industrial and laboratory equipment. Its main advantage is portability and ease of use. To carry out measurements, no highly qualified specialist is required to carry out measurements and any interventions in the equipment. Experimental measurement of the drawing force allows determining the friction coefficients depending on the process parameters, which in turn allows conducting research work to study the effect of the drawing tool and process lubricants on the energy-force parameters of the drawing process.

articleTitle: Development of an Electronic Differential System Based on Artificial Neural Networks for Electric Transport
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The transmission of most modern vehicles consists of an internal combustion engine (ICE) transmitting force through a gearbox to a differential shaft which transmits torque to the wheels. In electric vehicles, electric motors can be attached directly to the wheels through a reduction gearbox. If the control system is appropriate, the vehicle can transmit different torques to the wheels on each side of the vehicle to ensure high roadability. This system is called electronic differential. Its implementation can be either very simple, based on the Ackerman-Jeantand model, which cannot fully replace a simple mechanical differential, or based on robust control mechanisms with yaw moment. The latter method provides for a rather sophisticated control system and expensive sensors. However, there is the third approach which implies using neural networks to control the speed of electric vehicles. The method is simple, universal, and very flexible. However, most studies into this issue do not provide methods for developing this system in real form and present only theoretical calculations. This paper and research aim to provide materials and software to realize electronic differential based on artificial neural networks into practice.

articleTitle: Model of Automotive Alternator Output Voltage with Rectifier and Voltage Regulator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The automotive alternator is a key component of the power supply system that provides power to on-board consumers and battery charging. The alternator's technical condition can be assessed by comparing the available output voltage and the voltage of a healthy alternator. The impact of a rectifier and a voltage regulator on the alternator voltage needs to be determined. The authors established that the connection of a rectifier distorts the appearance of the alternator parameters due to the Zener diodes used in it. The dependencies are linearized: further voltage increase is determined by the increases in alternator rotor rotation speed and excitation current. When connecting the voltage regulator, the required alternator voltage can be provided using the pulse-width modulation of the excitation winding current. The duty factor of the excitation winding current cycle reduces along with the increase of the rotor speed and increases proportionally to the alternator load current. The adequacy of the analytical model of the excitation winding current was confirmed in experiments with the dynamic change cycle of its variables. The developed analytical models describe the changes in the output voltage of a healthy alternator. These will be used to develop an imitation model that can accurately identify typical alternator faults, which can be used in the development of an onboard monitoring system for the automobile power supply system condition.

articleTitle: Model of a Single-Zone Forging Induction Heater for Steel Cylindrical Workpieces
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article provides an overview of the numerical model of a single-zone forging induction heater for steel cylindrical workpieces. The calculation of the temperature distribution along the length of the “train” of workpieces is carried out taking into account changes in the electrical and magnetic properties of workpieces during induction heating. The change in the properties of the workpieces during the heating process is presented in the form of an iterative cycle that corrects the parameters of the workpieces at each calculation step. The implementation of this calculation method is presented in the form of a block diagram of the model. Based on the obtained graphs of changes in the heat dissipation power in the workpieces in the starting mode and the pattern of distribution of thermal and magnetic fields along the length of the “train” of workpieces, it can be concluded that the use of this iterative cycle allows to increase the accuracy of determining the parameters of the inductor.

articleTitle: Weighted Ontology Graph Construction for the Electrotechnical Sector from the Point of View of its Vulnerabilities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The work is devoted to the issue of security of the electrical sector from information threats arising due to the presence of vulnerabilities in its software. For this purpose, an approach (within the framework of Proof of Concept) is proposed for constructing an ontological model of the subject area. Such a model should also reflect the aspect of information security from the perspective of vulnerabilities and at the same time contain information about the importance of terms and their relationships for the subject area. A method has been developed for almost completely automatic construction of a model based on descriptions of vulnerabilities. The method consists of the following 7 steps: downloading vulnerabilities from the NVD repository; converting descriptions into a set of words-tokens; selection of words suitable for constructing an ontological model; normalization of tokens; selection of descriptions related to the electrical sector; calculating the weights of the importance of terms and their connections in the model; building an ontological model. To implement the method, a software prototype was developed, which made it possible to conduct a number of experiments. As a result, graphical representations of ontology kernels were obtained for the Top-10 and Top-20 most significant terms in the field - a weighted ontological graph. The shortcomings and limitations of the investigation and the results obtained, their rationale and ways to eliminate them are indicated.

articleTitle: Application of Power Transmission Lines with Backup Wire in Railway Power Supply Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The purpose of the research presented in this article was to develop digital models to define modes of electrical networks supplying traction substations (TS). It was assumed that part of the power line is equipped with backup wires (BW)., providing fast power supply recovery at emergence single-phase short circuits; with the disabled wire of a damaged phase being automatically replaced by a reserve one. Two designs of such power lines are considered: with one and three BWs. For comparison modeling of a feeding network with standard power line is done. Models were implemented in software complex Fazonord., version 5.3.3.0-2024. On their basis., a series of modes were determined., with loads created when five freight trains weighing 5000 tons move in even and odd directions. Calculations were carried out on basic frequency and frequencies of canonical higher harmonics: 3., 5., 7… 39. Also thermal processes modeling was done and time dependencies of heating temperatures of power line wires were built. For energy efficiency analysis active power losses in power lines were calculated. To estimate safety conditions calculations of electromagnetic fields of power lines were carried out. Developed digital models can be used in practice when choosing means to improve the reliability of power supply to AC traction substations.

Author Keywords: power supply systems for traction substations

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of Heat Supply Systems in Small and Medium-Sized Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The main problems of district heat supply systems in small and medium-sized cities are the low efficiency of thermal energy production and the high percentage of wear and tear of heating networks. The sources of thermal energy in these systems are heating and industrial heating boiler houses. The latter, due to technological features, have a low fuel efficiency, but in many cities with a population of up to 100,000 they predominate. Using the example of the work settlement of Linevo, the possibility of solving existing problems is shown: the possibility of building a cogeneration source of thermal energy based on gas piston units. This will reduce the specific fuel consumption for energy production. Reducing the cost of energy production will increase funding for the modernization of heating networks, which will lead to increased reliability of heat supply.

articleTitle: Optimization of Reactive Power Compensation in Low Voltage Networks Using Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper explores the optimization of single-phase reactive power compensation (RPC) in low-voltage networks using a particle swarm algorithm. Three optimization options are explored using the particle swarm algorithm - with and without sensitivity coefficients. In the first option, potential nodes for RPC are determined using sensitivity coefficients for reactive power and voltage. In the second, they are determined only using sensitivity factors for reactive power. Next, the nodes and capacities of the required devices are selected from the potential ones using a particle swarm algorithm. In the second option, the selection of connection points for compensation devices and their power is carried out using a particle swarm algorithm. In all cases, the same objective function is used, including costs and voltage deviation. The study of all RPC options was carried out on a model network. All calculations are implemented in the Python programming language. According to the results obtained, the most effective is the third optimization option - using the particle swarm algorithm, without using sensitivity coefficients. With such optimization, it is possible to reduce active power losses by 13.5% of the existing ones, improve the voltage values and zero-sequence asymmetry coefficient at network nodes.

articleTitle: Information Security for Oil and Gas Well Drilling Automation Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The development and complication of APCS information security make the associated problems more relevant. This is especially true for critical and potentially hazardous facilities that include almost all of the oil and gas sector. The vulnerabilities of distributed APCS occur due to various reasons including the use of wireless communications (public-key Wi-Fi encryption). Thus, the selection of the optimal data transfer protocol and encryption/decryption algorithm for the APCS of a specific industrial facility is a key stage in its design. This article reviews the encryption problems for wireless communication channels between the upper (SCADA) and middle (PLC), and middle and lower (sensors) levels of the automation system of drilling rigs and auxiliary facilities. The selection criteria included information security and power consumption because many APCS components have autonomous power sources. The authors demonstrate that, irrespective of the specific topology and physical implementation of the autonomous system transferring data over a radio channel, it is preferable to use symmetrical encryption algorithms, either block or flow. In most cases, the optimal solution facilitating the required level of information security and minimum power consumption is a symmetrical block AES algorithm.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Active Corrector of Power Factor with Cascaded Two Loops Control for Electric Locomotive's Auxiliary Electric Drive
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The object of study in the article is the auxiliary variable-frequency electric drive onboard of an AC electric locomotive, and more precisely, the structure and parameters of the control system of the active corrector of power factor (ACPF), which is part of the electric drive, as a unit that ensures electromagnetic compatibility of the electric drive with other equipment on board the electric locomotive and catenary and its energy efficiency. The topic of the article's research is the substantiation of the structure of the ACPF control system, the choice of types (transfer functions) of controllers and the calculation of their parameters. The research method chosen was the calculation of the transfer functions of the controllers of the cascaded loops control system, followed by computer simulation using the OrCAD software. The results of simulating a cascaded two loops control system of an ACPF with different types of controllers are presented and analytically compared. It is concluded that it is advisable to use a cascaded two loops control system, containing a voltage control loop and a current control loop. The best results show the simulation when using an aperiodic current controller (A-controller) and a proportional-integral voltage controller (PI-controller). The data obtained serve as the basis for further improvement of the operation of the ACPF by enhancing and optimizing the settings, structure and algorithms of the control system, which, with the selected hardware of power converter unit, will allow the ACPF to perform its functions with a high degree of reliability in an entire range of disturbing and control influences.

articleTitle: Study of Parameters of a 6 kV Distributed Electrical Network in the Tarror Quarry
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: To ensure uninterrupted supply of electric energy to electric receivers, as well as for safe and reliable maintenance of electrical installations under operating voltage, it is necessary to know the insulation parameters according to which organizational and technical measures are being developed, the use of which allows to obtain positive effects both social and economic. This article discusses the developed methodology for determining insulation parameters in quarry distribution networks. Using the developed methodology, a study was conducted in the “Tarror” quarry, during which the dynamics of changes in the insulation resistance of the network phases relative to the ground was evaluated. Based on the results obtained, it was concluded that it is advisable to carry out such measurements at least a year in advance, which will make it possible to draw reasonable qualitative and quantitative conclusions about the influence of environmental parameters on the insulation resistance of phases of quarry distribution networks relative to the ground.

Author Keywords: insulation resistance of the network relative to the ground

articleTitle: Analysis of Damage from Power Failure of Static Thyristor Compensator in Electric Arc Furnace System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article considers the influence of the static thyristor compensator (STC) on the performance of the arc melting furnace (AMF). The relationship between the power and voltage of the AMF, the stabilization of which is ensured by the STC, is presented. To assess the damage, statistics of failures of electrical equipment that ensures the continuity of the AMF and STC are provided. The analysis and impact of the current voltage at the point of common connection on the electrical equipment of the main step-down substation (GPP) of the AMF is carried out. Particular attention is paid to the end couplings of power cables with a rated voltage of 35–42 kV. The work calculates the damage from a decrease in the AMF productivity due to an interruption in the power supply to the STC as a result of the predominant failures of cable lines (CL). When calculating the damage, the average time required for restoration in real production conditions is taken into account.

articleTitle: Experience of Using the Frequency Response Analysis Method in Interpreting Defects of 10–500 kV Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper presents a methodology for evaluating Frequency Response Analysis (FRA) results based on the standard deviation (SD) coefficient. The methodology is applied to a case study involving the evaluation of FRA results for a power transformer with a voltage of 10–500 kV. The paper also presents a method of dynamic division of the frequency region for the determination of winding and core zones based on the analysis of local extrema. The results of transformer measurements in the presence of radial and axial winding deformations, short-circuited in the winding, and deformation of the core are presented. The possibilities of analysis by capacitive inter-winding measurement schemes are shown. It is demonstrated that the application of the DL/T-911 method can lead to erroneous estimation of FRA results.

articleTitle: A Method for Calculating Capacitive Currents, with a Single-Phase Earth Fault, Using the Parameters of Emergency and Pre-Emergency Modes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Single-phase earth faults are the most common problem in networks with isolated neutral. The development and improvement of the hardware of modern microprocessor relay protection devices and measuring transformers make it possible to implement new and more advanced algorithms. The concept of development of the electric power industry - “digital transformation-2030”, developed by Rosseti, involves the introduction of communication channels, including on lines 6-35kV. In addition, optoelectronic measuring transformers with high measurement accuracy are being actively developed and put into operation [1]. This makes it possible to implement two-way relay protection and automation algorithms on 6-35kV lines and, above all, the function of determining the location of damage (FL). To organize the operation of such relay protection and automation algorithms designed to eliminate single-phase earth faults in networks with an isolated neutral, it is necessary to calculate the capacitive currents flowing in intact phases relative to the ground and in phase-to-phase capacitances. The article describes in detail the method developed by the authors for calculating capacitive currents in single-phase earth faults using the parameters of emergency and pre-emergency modes.

articleTitle: Information Technologies for Analytical Processing of Large Volumes of Data on Cybersecurity Events Using Supercomputers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Currently, cybersecurity issues for critical infrastructures are complicated by the need to process large amounts of data on security events. This leads to the need to develop an information technology that combines analytical processing of big data on security events with supercomputing. The paper discusses the main provisions of such technology. The general scheme of the developed technology and the architecture of the system realizing it are proposed. The paper presents a high-level and low-level description of the system architecture. Experimental results of evaluation of the developed technology obtained at the supercomputer center “Polytechnik” are presented. These results confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed information technology and demonstrated its high performance.

articleTitle: Ensuring a Reliable Power Supply for Railway Traffic Lights Using Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article discusses the power supply system of a railway automation and telemechanics device, namely a railway traffic light (hereinafter referred to as a traffic light), using solar energy as an alternative power source. An analysis of the characteristics of various rechargeable batteries showed the advantages and disadvantages of each type of rechargeable battery. Rechargeable batteries are used as backup power sources and must be kept in good condition at all times. The operating principle of gel and lead-acid batteries used in railway transport is the same, however, due to the gel electrolyte, gel batteries have a number of advantages. The transition to gel batteries will increase the reliability and quality of the power supply system for automation and remote control equipment. The productivity of a photovoltaic installation was calculated for two regions of the Republic of Uzbekistan. An analysis was made of the use of solar energy, and the advantages of autonomous power plants were described. The use of small solar photovoltaic installations operating in parallel with the network will improve the reliability of railway automation and telemechanics devices.

Author Keywords: power supply of railway traffic lights

articleTitle: Reactive Power Control for Grid-Connected Inverters with PPWM at a Constant Modulation Index
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article is devoted to the development of a method for controlling reactive power of grid-connected inverters (GCIs) with pre-programmable pulse width modulation (PPWM) at a constant modulation index. The paper describes the GCI reactive power control modes, mathematical expressions for relationship between the reactive power level, DC link voltage, and modulation index. It allows us to determine the required voltage in the GCI DC link that provides a required level of reactive power generation or consumption at a constant modulation index. The article presents the experimental results of laboratory studies to confirm the operability of the proposed GCI control method for reactive power control. The oscillograms demonstrate reactive power compensation modes at a level of 10 kvar. The developed method can be used to compensate reactive power by GCI with PPWM.

articleTitle: Main Lines Hybrid Device for Symmetrizing Phase Currents for 0.4 kV
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The relevance of this topic lies in the need to increase the reliability of electrical systems and to enable more efficient use of existing resources for energy production. The application of a hybrid phase balancing device for 0.4 kV busbars allows for significant reduction of risks of emergency situations and improves the quality of internal energy distribution within the system. An analysis of electrical load profiles and 0.4 kV busbar lines has been conducted, technical data of the hybrid phase balancing device has been studied. Voltage losses in the 0.4 kV lines have been determined, maximum current loads and short-circuit currents have been calculated. The selection of the installation location for the balancing device has also been discussed. The type of hybrid phase balancing device has been chosen. Suggestions for improving energy efficiency have been proposed, and energy savings have been calculated.

articleTitle: On the Issue of Electric Starter Start Systems with Alternative Current Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In recent years, much attention has been paid to the use of capacitive energy storage devices (ES) as sources of electrical energy in electric starter start (SES) systems of an internal combustion engine (ICE). The conducted experimental studies show that the process of starting the SEP internal combustion engine with ES is significantly different from the start-up process when the starter motor (SEM) is powered by a rechargeable battery (B). In a number of works [1], [2], experimental studies of the processes of scrolling the VAZ-21073 automobile engine when powered by high-voltage ES with different values of the initial charging voltage were carried out. However, this issue has not been practically investigated, there are no recommendations on the choice of the initial charging voltage of the ES, which makes it difficult to manufacture such systems. This article presents the results of a theoretical study on the effect of the value of the initial charging voltage of the ES on the main characteristics of the SES for automotive internal combustion engines equipped with standard SEM. In this case, the initial data are the starting and mechanical characteristics of the internal combustion engine, the type of SEM, its nominal operating characteristics and the total active resistance r., the gear ratio of the drive from the SEM to the ICE. The starting characteristics of the internal combustion engine at different temperatures are determined experimentally and represent the dependence of the start time tp on the average rotational speed <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$n$</tex> of the crankshaft.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of the Remaining Useful Life of the Continuous Casting Machine Mold through the Introduction of Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper considers the application of digital twin technology for predictive analysis of the remaining useful life of the mold of a continuous casting machine. The analysis of scientific and technical literature is carried out, the architecture of the digital twin of the continuous casting machine is described. The electronic passport is the basis for the structure of the digital twin as a data base. Thus, a combined architecture is implemented. Machine learning models for determining the hydraulic and thermal parameters of the copper walls of the mold are presented. These models formed the basis of the digital twin of the mold of the continuous casting machine.

articleTitle: Industrial VSWR Automation Module in the EHF Range
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: With the development of 5/6G communication systems in the electronic field, the task of research and development of functional nodes operating at frequencies of 25 GHZ and above arises. At the same time, the availability and accessibility of digital metrological complexes is very limited, which imposes a number of requirements for research. An alternative method for analyzing wave processes in microwave technology is numerical methods and the design of digital counterparts of real devices in order to optimize. This approach also requires verification based on a physical experiment. This article proposes the use of digitization modules of analog metrological devices for digital processing of the received measurements. The proposed method makes it possible to use existing and more affordable technical solutions and combine them with numerical methods. Also, the proposed metrological complexes consisting of a universal digitization module and a measuring device can optimize the quality control process of the developed microwave technology modules. The paper proposes a layout of the system based on a digitization module and a panoramic VSWR meter, models of which can measure from 1 GHz to 150 GHz. Software based on the Labview graphical language has been developed for data processing. The experimental results showed the adequacy of the proposed solution and the possibility of integrating the metrological complex into the technological process of manufacturing microwave components as a verification device. The error of the measurements obtained can be reduced by using an ADC with a higher bit depth and frequency of disretization.

articleTitle: Aluminium Mesh Transparent Conductor with Irregular Structure as Effective EMI Shielding Material
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Using a self-organized template made by cracking a thin film of egg white, effective irregular aluminum mesh transparent conductor (Al MTC) is obtained. The resulting Al MTCs are characterized by a sheet resistance of 12.26 Ω/sq, while the transmittance in the visible region is 83.15%. Transmission and reflection coefficients for Al MTC in the microwave range, 0.7-14 GHz, were measured using an antenna stand with horn antennas. It is shown that irregular Al MTC has an excellent combination of optical transparency, more than 83%, and shielding efficiency (SE) of more than 25 dB in the range of 0.7-14 GHz. At the same time, it is resistant to bending and compression deformations, in contrast to standard ITO coatings on flexible substrates.

articleTitle: The Effect of the Power Focusing Mode on the Flow of Molten Metal in a Two-Section Induction Crucible Furnace
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Induction heating is currently well studied, so the main tasks in this area have already been solved, but there are problems associated with optimizing the technological process. The electromagnetic stirring of the melt is considered in the article. In the course of the study, modeling and analysis of the behavior of the melt in an induction crucible furnace were carried out. A method is proposed to accelerate the mixing of the melt by changing the distribution of electrodynamic forces by changing the focusing of power in sections of a height-partitioned inductor. It has been revealed what effect the power is focused in which section of the inductor has on the nature and velocity of the metal flow in the crucible.

Author Keywords: control of the flow of molten metal

articleTitle: Case Study of Application Scenario of Electrical Complex VSC-MTDC in the Syrian Arab Republic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: For a number of reasons, electrical complexes of a multi-terminal direct current transmission system (MTDC) based on a voltage source converter (VSC) have attracted much attention from the academic and industrial communities. Currently, developments are underway to create such electrical complexes: the JO-SY-TR project, DESERTEC, GOBITEC, etc. Despite the obvious advantages of using VSC - MTDC, their large-scale implementation requires solving a number of research and operational problems. This article is focused on studying the control aspect of a VSC - MTDC electrical complex consisting of four terminals (Syria, Lebanon, Jordan and Turkey) connected to the DESERTEC ±500 kV DC system, in order to implement and test various objective functions. Testing operations were performed using the MATLAB/Simulink software package.

articleTitle: Simulation of a Single-Pole Generator with Permanent Magnets
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Improving the quality of functioning of a modern urban vehicle (V) is inextricably linked with solving a set of tasks to improve safety, reliability, comfort and environmental friendliness. To solve these tasks, the world leaders of V production are actively engaged in the development and implementation of electrical control systems, alarm systems, lighting, safety and comfort, which ensure their effective solution. The introduction of such systems entails an increase in electricity consumption, an increase in the power and size of generator sets (GS) on the vehicle. To date, modern compact generators are being actively developed and implemented on domestic V, the power of such generators in some cases reaches up to 2000 watts, however, this power is not enough on board. In addition, a serious problem of V operation in modern conditions is the significant time of its operation at idle of the internal combustion engine (ICE), when the current generated by the generator is significantly less than the maximum value [1]. It is possible to solve the problems by further increasing the power of the GS while simultaneously reducing the initial rotational speed of the generator rotor without a load corresponding to the starting point of the current-speed characteristic of the generator. At the same time, the overall dimensions of the generator are limited by the possibilities of its placement in the engine compartment of the V

articleTitle: Simulation of Operating Modes of Traction Substation Batteries in Operational DC Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The construction of digital traction substations implies the development and further application of systems for monitoring the technical condition of equipment. The introduction of modern monitoring systems makes it possible to ensure the transition to maintenance according to technical condition and the use of sparsely populated technologies, by reducing or eliminating a number of measurements and tests that can be carried out by diagnostic devices in automatic mode. The batteries of traction substations provide an increase in the reliability of the equipment when the external power supply is disconnected from the operational DC system. The transition to maintenance-free digital traction substations requires substantiation of the list of diagnostic indicators of battery operation to monitor their technical condition and predict the remaining life. To predict the remaining life, it is proposed to use battery models formed on the basis of the characteristics and load modes of operational DC systems, factory characteristics and battery performance. The developed model was verified based on measurements of the battery performance of a traction substation.

articleTitle: Verification of Simulation of the Temperature Influence on the Characteristics of Microstrip Line with Two Side Grounded Conductors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article presents the verification of simulation of the influence of temperature <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\boldsymbol(T)}$</tex> on the characteristics of a microstrip line (MSL) with two side grounded conductors. The verification was performed using two programs: MATLAB and TALGAT. To investigate the influence of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\boldsymbol(T)}$</tex>, we used a simple temperature model based on the thermal coefficient that determines the linear thermal changes of the materials of printed circuit boards (PCBs) of radioelectronic equipment (REE). As a base material, we chose FR-4 since it is widely used as a substrate for PCBs in REE, being cost-effective and reliable (having a high glass transition temperature <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\boldsymbol(Tg)}$</tex>. As a conductor material, we chose ordinary copper. The influence of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\boldsymbol(T)}$</tex> (-50, 25, 150 °C) was verified using a variation of parameters affecting the sensitivity (stability) of the MSL characteristics, namely the per-unit-length delay <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\tau)$</tex> and the characteristic impedance <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\boldsymbol(Z)}$</tex>. Consistency of results was obtained for both characteristics at all values of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\boldsymbol(T)}$</tex> with a maximum deviation of about 2%. In conclusion, to ensure the accuracy of our simulation results, additional verification was performed using the ADS program.

articleTitle: Developing Digital Twin for Electromechanical System of Rolling Stand in Simulink Real Time
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The development of digital twins (DTs) of industrial electrical systems is attributed to the need for the reduction of time and material resource inputs during their virtual commissioning (VC). The same problem occurs during renovation with complete or partial equipment replacement and/or control systems. These problems can be efficiently solved by developing object-oriented DTs based on the Simulink Real Time software and using hardware-in-the-loop simulation (HIL). This software is compatible with Matlab Simulink and the Simscape package, which makes it suitable for the industrial usage. The authors suggest a HIL-based approach that helps make a virtual real-time computer model, with process control signals coming from the industrial PLC that controls the real physical object. This problem occurred during the renovation of the horizontal stand electric drives of a 5000 plate mill. The authors provide the flow charts of the electromechanical system and the object-oriented DT. The implementation of DT in Matlab Simulink Desktop Real Time is reviewed in laboratory settings. The authors present the block structures that make up a virtual model of the electromechanical system. The developed DT was used to adjust control algorithms and controllers and study the dynamic modes over a rolling cycle. The adequacy of the processes was tested by comparing the oscillograms obtained with the developed DT and the rolling mill. The authors stress the feasibility of developing DTs on the Simulink Real Time platform using HIL simulation during VC and renovation of complex industrial objects.

articleTitle: Determination of Generalised Parameters of Large Power Systems By the Diacoptics Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper discusses the diacoptics method for determining generalised parameters of large power systems. Generalised parameters are necessary for various calculations in power engineering, such as estimation of short-circuit currents, power losses, steady-state and optimal modes, transient analysis, and finding losses in the network. For power systems of medium complexity there are methods that are successfully applied in practice, but for large systems with the number of nodes 1000 and more they are not sufficiently developed. The diacoptics method is based on the decomposition of the power system into simpler subsystems, for each of which generalised parameters are calculated separately. These parameters are then combined to obtain an overall solution. The authors propose a new approach, eliminating the sequential build-up of the power system scheme by considering all branches of the network at once. This significantly reduces the number of computational operations and improves the efficiency of calculations. The paper also presents an example of the application of the method on a power system scheme with 11 nodes and 21 branches. The application of the proposed method has shown its high efficiency and feasibility for use in the calculations of large power systems, which contributes to a more reliable and optimal operation of power networks, hence reducing the calculation errors and increasing the accuracy. The diacoptics method proposed in the paper is an important tool for the analysis and optimisation of large power systems, ensuring their stable and efficient operation.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Incomplete Phase Mode of a Power Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article considers the causes and consequences of sequential ferroresonance in electrical networks in incomplete-phase operation modes of a power transformer. Transformations of substitution circuits of electrical installations are presented to determine the values of capacitances that cause ferroresonance processes in the circuit. Physical models have been constructed to study the features of sequential ferroresonance. Waveforms and vector diagrams are presented that characterize the voltage increase at the disconnected phase of the transformer with its overturning. The peculiarities of changing the capacitance of the damaged connection in the ferroresonance mode are shown. Studies have been conducted for electrical networks with isolated and deafly grounded neutral.

Author Keywords: incomplete phase mode of the power transformer

articleTitle: Study of Frequency Characteristics of a Voltage Sensor Based on System of Galvanically Coupled Bodies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Measuring voltage in electrical networks is an important task in ensuring its stable and uninterrupted operation. The design of a high-voltage measuring system of industrial frequency based on a system of galvanically coupled bodies is proposed. A mathematical model of a sensor with a matching device, including an instrumentation amplifier and an integrator, is described. The results of the conducted analysis of the frequency characteristics of the elements of the matching device are presented. The harmonic composition of the voltage at the output of each of the elements that make up the measurement system was measured and compared with the reference values. During the experiment, the adequacy of the mathematical model, as well as the correctness of the selection of elements, was confirmed. The results showed that the developed voltage sensor based on a system of galvanically coupled bodies with a matching unit meets the permissible requirements for the accuracy of high voltage measurement at least up to the 9th harmonic.

articleTitle: Intelligent Production Well Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The development of electronics and the complication of process control technologies has great potential in improving the efficiency of industrial process control. Microprocessor controllers, wireless communication, intelligent control systems, contactless sensors and other technologies used in the oil industry can serve as the basis for the creation of a fundamentally new intelligent process control system, one of the components of which is an intelligent well. When operating an oil production well, it is necessary to take into account the technological features of the oil recovery well, the functioning of the elements of the electrical complex of the production well, disturbing effects on the electrical and technological parts [1], [2]. Together, the intelligent production well control system will ensure optimal operation of process equipment and reduce power consumption, which will affect the cost of production.

articleTitle: The Network Resources Optimization in Tele- and Infocommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article proposes an algorithm to solve optimization issue for network resources depending on the requirements for throughput. The optimization problem is formulated as the task of ensuring the structural reliability for communication network. The network is represented as a state graph with a finite number of switching nodes and communication lines. For it compile such arguments as the network topology and the number of operating communication directions, the capacity of switching nodes and the technical condition of the network is taken into account. By using a simulation program, the throughput of each communication line is analyzed, the availability factor and the level of consumer demand are calculated. The result of the solution is proposed as a number of options for redistributing network resources to meet consumer demand. The program does not consider the presence of backup communication lines or alternative routes that are in inactive mode. The choice of the best option depends on the selected redistribution criterion.

Index Terms: Pairs Of Nodes In The Network

articleTitle: Development of an Automated Irrigation Control System with Electrochemically Activated Water in Greenhouse Complexes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper deals with the development of an automated irrigation system in greenhouse complexes using electrochemically activated water. The main focus is on the integration of modern sensors, pumps, valves, and control systems based on PLC and PC for precise control and regulation of temperature, air and soil humidity, and soil pH. The use of electrochemical water activation products (anolyte and catholyte) has shown significant effects on plant health and growth, helping to reduce disease and improve nutrient availability. Mathematical modeling was used to analyze and optimize the irrigation system, allowing for the prediction of its behavior under different conditions and the development of effective management strategies. The implementation of the automated system and the developed control algorithm leads to a significant reduction in water and energy use. The results of the study confirm the value of this innovative approach to improving the productivity and sustainability of greenhouse agriculture.

articleTitle: Protection of the Rectifier in Converter Installation Using Reed Switches
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: It is noted that the disadvantages of the traditional method of protecting rectifiers in converter installations during valve failures include low speed and sensitivity. As an alternative, the use of miniature magnetic-sensitive sensors, reed switches, which have proven themselves well in technology, is proposed. It is mentioned that at Toraighyrov University, the first attempt was made to develop protection for the rectifier in a converter installation using reed switches. It is emphasized that at low load currents, such protection may have insufficient sensitivity due to the need to roughen the settings. An improved protection device is proposed, which eliminates this drawback by using a bias winding for each reed switch, three current relays, an additional auxiliary power source, and a signaling unit. The behavior of the protection in various operating modes of the converter installation is analyzed. It is shown that monitoring the health of the bias windings can significantly reduce potential protection failures in operation.

articleTitle: Modeling of Electrical Power System with Distributed Generation Source
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Analysis and modeling of an electrical power system with a distributed generation source in normal mode were carried out using the Matlab application program. The paper provides an analysis of the state of the electric power system, the main parameters of which change when an additional source of distributed generation based on a wind farm with a capacity of 9 MVA is introduced. A block diagram and, based on it, a simulation model of the power system have been compiled. Since the stability of the electric power system depends on the reliable operation of the emergency automatics, it is necessary to determine the values of the main parameters of the electric power system that characterize its stable operation: the change in the phase shift angle between the emf of the generator and the network voltage and the change in the main electrical quantities at the consumer source terminals.

articleTitle: Energy Storage in the Subway Electric Drives Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article concentrates on building an energy-saving model for the subway power supply system, which, combined with modern adjustable speed induction motor drives, controls current flows between the contact network, the power network and energy storage unit under the contact network (current) load. The energy-saving model provides significant energy savings, line up the power network daily load periods by using the storage unit energy to compensate contact network peak loads. Controlled active rectifiers as part of the energy-saving model ensure (with sufficient accuracy) constant-voltage regulation in the contact network, absence of higher harmonics in the power network and zero shift between the main current harmonic and contact network voltage. The energy storage unit in the supply network is a lithium-ion battery equipped with DC-to-DC converter with battery charge-discharge loop controller. Energy flows are controlled by changing the battery's charge-discharge current within the contact network charging rate and electric current mark using a controller framework. The power supply energy-saving model simulation resulted in drawing oscillograph charts, which confirm the model's efficiency in the main subway rolling stock modes of operation.

articleTitle: Enhancing Robotic Adaptability: Integrating Unsupervised Trajectory Segmentation and Conditional ProMPs for Dynamic Learning Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: We propose a novel framework for enhancing robotic adaptability and learning efficiency, which integrates unsupervised trajectory segmentation with adaptive probabilistic movement primitives (ProMPs). By employing a cutting-edge deep learning architecture that combines autoencoders and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), our approach autonomously pinpoints critical transitional points in continuous, unlabeled motion data, thus significantly reducing dependence on extensively labeled datasets. This innovative method dynamically adjusts motion trajectories using conditional variables, significantly enhancing the flexibility and accuracy of robotic actions under dynamic conditions while also reducing the computational overhead associated with traditional robotic programming methods. Our experimental validation demonstrates superior learning efficiency and adaptability compared to existing techniques, paving the way for advanced applications in industrial and service robotics.

articleTitle: Study of Initialization Options for Applications with Automatic Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Automatic machine learning systems are becoming more and more in demand with the increasing use of neural networks in various products. And it is necessary to prepare a pipeline for them, in which the neural network may require additional training. This is what this work focused on - examination of various approaches to initializing the weights of neural networks for its use in an automatic garbage sorting facility. During the work, three strategies for initializing weights have been proposed, which seem to be the most efficient. We describe the datasets used to compare initialization strategies; the studies conducted, which contain several ways to change the dataset in the process of modeling the operation of the system and show obtained results, based on which some conclusions are made. The result of the work is recommendations on the use of strategies in specific cases encountered in the development of automated machine learning systems.

articleTitle: Calculation of the Traction Induction Motor Performance Characteristics Using a Dynamic Computer Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The method of traction asynchronous motor performance characteristics calculation using an induction motor dynamic computer model developed in this paper. The relevance of this paper is the usage of a dynamic computer model for getting induction motor performance characteristics in relative measurement units. This option may be useful for different electric motor comparisons. The purpose of this paper is to develop the performance characteristics calculation method and its application for induction squirrel-cage motor using a Matlab Simulink dynamic computer model. For this purpose, the authors use the theory of electric machines and electric drives and Matlab Simulink environment [20]. The novelty lies in the flaw enumeration of traditional modelling performance characteristics obtaining approach. A new method of power and load torque setting was developed. The result of the study is a representation of the quasi-steady stator current, load torque, and angle speed of the induction motor in relative units [21] with time-synchronized mechanic power. The practical significance of the paper is the calculated performance characteristics of the DTA-350M traction induction motor within its mechanical power range between 0,1 and 2,5 P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2N</inf>.

articleTitle: Research on Improving the Quality of Induction Units Using Multi-Pulse ATRU
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article discusses the features of operation of induction units (IU) in industry for heat treatment of metal parts, the main connection schemes of such units, analyzes known difficulties arising during operation of the described complexes, including the negative inverse effect of distribution and consumption of electromagnetic interferences and currents of higher harmonics in the power supply, load and other consumers. The main methods of eliminating the effect of higher harmonics of currents for IU are analyzed. A power supply circuit for induction heating (IH) units based on a multi-pulse (using the example of an 18-pulse) autotransformer-rectifier unit (ATRU) is proposed and its computer simulation is performed in the Matlab software package with an analysis of processes. The total harmonic distortion of input current of such a power supply are calculated in comparison with typical 6-pulse transformer-rectifier unit (TRU). Graphs of electromagnetic processes were obtained and analyzed during the simulation of various inverter circuits in induction heating units (IHU).

articleTitle: The Trend in the Development of Monitoring in the Field of Renewable Energy Sources Based on Internet of Things Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Currently, based on the analysis of domestic and foreign experience in the development of the microgeneration market based on renewable energy sources (RES), it can be concluded that through the implementation of a well-thought-out industrial policy, it is possible to ensure an accelerated transition to a carbon-free economy and stimulate economic growth. Currently, there are a number of reasons why it is necessary to conduct planned studies of the state of photovoltaic modules, various scientists are already working in this direction using various technologies, including artificial intelligence. The article discusses the trend in the development of automated monitoring using IoT technologies. At the beginning of 2020, there were already 7.6 billion working IoT devices in the world. A study published by Transforma Insights says that in 2030 their number will grow to 24.1 billion, which is an average of 12-13%.

articleTitle: Sensor System for Determining the Angular Position of a Large Objects in Difficult Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: As part of this work, a sensor system has been developed that is used to determine the angular value of a large object in difficult conditions. An airplane is used as a large-sized object in the process of carrying out work on writing magnetic deviation. The main features of the process of carrying out deviation works, as well as the features of the deviation clocks used, are analyzed. The main limitations corresponding to the use of existing ready-made solutions for measuring the angle of rotation of an aircraft have been identified. An integrated approach to the construction of a sensor system is proposed, combining the use of sensors based on various physical principles. To roughly determine the direction, the use of RFID methods is proposed, applied on the surface of the deviation clock. To accurately determine the angle of rotation, it is proposed to use a technical vision system that recognizes rhumb marks applied to the surface of the deviation clock. The structure of the sensor system has been developed. The basic requirements for its implementation are described. An algorithm has been developed for processing information from various sensors that are part of the sensor system.

articleTitle: Thermodynamic Calculation of the Working Process of the Gas-Dynamically Decoupled Compressor and Turbine
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article describes a thermodynamic calculation of the working process of a gas-dynamically decoupled compressor and turbine. Samara University is designing microturbine for the needs of distributed energy, so the task was set to develop a model to determine the readiness of the infrastructure and the required equipment capacity for full-scale testing. The model of designed microturbine was used to create the model of the working process of a gas-dynamically decoupled compressor and turbine. The absence of a gas-dynamic connection between the compressor and the turbine makes it possible to obtain experimental map of the small-scaled compressors in a wide range of operating modes. To drive the compressor, compressed air is supplied to the section in front of the turbine. At the same time, since the working fluid has an ambient temperature, the task is to determine the parameters of the air at the outlet of the turbine, the low temperature values of which in some operating modes can lead to icing of the test bench elements and affect the quality of the experiment. The main result of the work was the determination of compressor map points that can be experimentally obtained. Thermodynamic parameters of the working process at these points provide to design of a spiral air collector behind the compressor, design of the air supply to the turbine using a receiver or volute, designing the air exhaust from the turbine, determining the operating conditions of the bench elements, for example, butterfly valves, for their correct selection.

articleTitle: The Review of the Unmanned Robotic Platforms for Diagnostic of Power Lines and Transmission Towers Under Voltage
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The reliability and continuity of power supply depends on the technical condition of power lines. Therefore, diagnostics and maintenance of power lines is one of the priority tasks of the energy sector. Today, more and more attention is being paid to the maintenance of power equipment according to its condition. The main trend in the inspection of power lines and transmission towers, which allows monitoring their serviceability in real time, is currently the research and development of unmanned robotic systems capable of monitoring the technical condition of power line nodes, identifying malfunctions at an early stage of their development. The article presents the requirements for robotic platforms for diagnosing power lines and transmission towers under the voltage, reviews existing solutions in this area, identifies the advantages and disadvantages of existing prototypes and identifies prospects for their development.

articleTitle: Development of a System for Automatic Identification of a Problem Areas of Extended Objects Using AUV
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper describes the developed system for automatic identification of problem areas of extended objects using autonomous unmanned underwater vehicles (AUVs) based on data obtained from technical vision systems (TVS), in particular multibeam sonars. The proposed system allows a three-dimensional model of the pipeline to be dynamically constructed in real time on the AUV's on-board computer, based on point clouds received from the TVS. Based on this model, the position of an extended object in space and its curvature are automatically determined, as well as the degree of immersion of the pipe in the seabed. The system generates information about the condition of the pipeline, which can be sent to the post using a hydroacoustic communication channel. The software implementation of the system is implemented in the Python programming language. The system has been studied using numerical modelling in the CoppeliaSim environment. The simulation results confirmed the operability of the system and the high efficiency of its use.

articleTitle: Exploit's Code Model for Cyber Security Analysis of Industrial Processes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Cyber security risk management is one of the essential aspects of the industrial processes control. Exploits are often used for cyber attacks for the exploitation of known and previously unseen vulnerabilities and can lead to serious consequences for industrial system security. Accurate forecasting and assessment of these consequences can enhance security risk management processes and, consequently, industrial processes control. For this goal, the paper proposes a new approach to automated exploits assessment and detection based on the exploit's compiled code model. The main idea consists, on the one hand, in revealing of the relations between the metrics of the vulnerability, used within the exploit, and system calls and their dependencies for further classification of the exploits of one type and severity. On the other hand, it consists in the revealing of such relations between system calls and their dependencies and sequences of the events detected in the system under analysis for further detection of parts of the events sequences to forecast exploitation of previously unseen vulnerabilities and assess appropriate exploits and cyberattacks. The authors introduce the methodology for cyberattack assessment based on the proposed approach, the new exploit's code model for the exploits classification and assessment considering related vulnerability metrics, as well as the general exploit's code model for further detection and assessment of previously unknown exploits and attacks.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of PID, Stanley, and Hybrid (PID with Stanley) Control Algorithms on Bitum Line-Follower Road Coaster
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper introduces an augmented Stanley-PID controller, termed Hybrid, aimed at enhancing the line tracking accuracy of autonomous road coasters, specifically Bitum. The primary focus lies in implementing precise line tracking control for Bitum, thereby contributing to the advancement of smart autonomous vehicle technologies. Emphasizing the operational requirements of road coasters, our controller was deployed on a non-linear road to ensure that the maximum absolute error of the rear wheel remained below 5~[cm]. Through simulation tests, we validated the efficacy of our proposed algorithm. Comparative analysis was conducted against both PID (Proportional-Integral-Derivative) and original Stanley controllers. While PID parameters were fine-tuned using the Nicolas-Ziegler method, Stanley's parameters were adjusted as per the recommendations in the original paper. Notably, our proposed method exhibited superior performance, particularly evident during increased speeds, when compared to both PID and Stanley controllers.

articleTitle: An Improved Three-Phase Monopolar Generator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of the design of a double-power monopolar generator. In previous studies, the authors proposed a brushless generator of a new design, the winding coils of which are located on the stator, including the field winding. In the improved model of the monopolar generator a doubling of the output power with the same dimensions, as well as a decrease in specific mass, is achieved. The advantage of the design is the filling of the stator circumference with a coefficient of 0.75, which gives a twofold larger total area of the stator coil teeth. On a 3D model, the basic properties of the generator were obtained using the finite element method and the operating mode on the load with different capacitance values was studied. The obtained results are shown in an easy-to-understand form and allow an independent assessment of the new generator design.

articleTitle: Applications of Solid Insulation for High-Voltage Equipment of Different Voltage Classes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The research focuses on solid polymer insulation, specifically on certain operational factors affecting the parameters of solid polymer insulation. For a more detailed examination of solid polymer insulation, the article provides a classification of polymers, commonly used materials, and the main insulation parameters considered in the initial stages of insulation design. The authors investigate several operational factors, such as the active volume of insulation, exposure time to voltage, and insulation structure, influencing the dielectric strength of solid polymer insulation. The derived dependencies and patterns can be directly used to assess the dielectric strength of large-volume polymer insulation; in selecting the permissible value of dielectric strength for cast epoxy insulation in weakly non-uniform and sharply non-uniform electric fields under different voltage exposure durations; and for modifying the electric field in the insulation gap. The dielectric strengths of cast epoxy insulation, considering the examined operational parameters, were experimentally determined.

articleTitle: Testing of a Diesel Generator Set As Included in a Solar-Diesel Complex
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of diesel genset unit (DGU) operation as a part of solar-diesel complex (SDC). The description of the technical facilities of the research site “Solar-Diesel Complex” (SDC) is made. Possible regimes of functioning of diesel equipment as a part of SDC are considered. The testing of the SDC was performed, the equipment was adjusted and prepared for further tests. On the basis of real data obtained from SDC, located in the city of Verkhoyansk, modeling of its operation was performed and experimental studies of possible regimes were carried out, on the example of some of them graphical and numerical control was performed in order to verify the fulfillment of the power balance.

articleTitle: Development and Comparison of Methods for Predicting the Technical Condition of Alternators Powered By Gas Piston Engines Based on the Analysis of an Array of Historical Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Obviously, the effectiveness of diagnostics increases significantly when the task of predicting changes in the state of an object at future points in time is solved. This is due to the fact that the ability to predict unmanageable aspects of the operation of an object before making a decision to put it into repair allows you to make an optimal choice of the timing and scope of repair work. Currently, there are several approaches to solving the problem of forecasting the technical condition, including methods based on the analysis of historical data, the advantage of which is to take into account the influence of external factors such as the interval between repairs, the quality of maintenance and repair, sudden changes in loads, etc. The purpose of this study is to develop and compare models for predicting the technical condition of alternators powered by a gas piston engine (gas piston units) based on an array of historical data on the technical condition. Adaptive neuro-fuzzy network and regression models of time series were used in the development of models. Conclusions are drawn about the highest accuracy of the regression model of the Gaussian process to describe the process of changing the technical condition of gas piston units. The proposed methods made it possible to accurately predict changes in the technical condition of gas piston units, taking into account the influence of external factors. The results obtained can be used as a basis for the creation of predictive maintenance systems for gas piston units.

articleTitle: Hardware and Software Complex for Express Diagnostics of Overhead Power Line Insulators
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The presented article considers a method of contact less diagnostics of overhead power transmission line (OHL) insulators based on the partial discharge (PD) method. For express diagnostics of OHL insulators, a hardware and software complex (HSC) was developed based on a laptop and an FM receiver with a telescopic antenna. PD data were transferred to the laptop memory using an analog-to-digital converter (ADC), accumulated in a database and processed using a specially developed algorithm that takes into account the noise level, weather conditions, distance to insulators and their strings. The algorithm is based on calculating the average values of partial discharges calculated over several dozen periods of applied voltage. The proposed algorithm was preliminarily tested in laboratory conditions using a standard R-400 device, as a result of which it was found that the frequency of relatively small partial discharges increases before breakdown, as a result of which the average level of partial discharges decreases, which formed the basis of the algorithm for express diagnostics of the state of insulators of overhead power transmission lines.

Author Keywords: diagnostics of overhead power transmission line insulators

articleTitle: Implementation and Research of the Adaptive Law of Control of the Movement of the Hoist in the Working Area of the Overhead Crane
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In this paper, we consider one of the potential algorithms for the operation of a bridge crane. During its functioning, load fluctuations can occur, which can lead to wear and damage of equipment, as well as create a risk for working personnel. To address this issue, we propose implementing an adaptive control system for the drive of the bridge crane. This system consists of several components, including a sigmoidal trajectory generator, adapter, identifier, and regulator. The sigmoidal trajectory generator creates the desired trajectory for the movement of the load. The adapter and identifier determine the changing parameters during the crane's operation. Based on this information, the regulator issues appropriate control actions. We conducted simulations using MATLAB Simulink with the “cart-pendulum” model to analyze the effectiveness of this approach in reducing fluctuations in the transported load. The results of the analysis show the benefits of the proposed method. This, in turn, extends the operational life of the electromechanical components of the overhead crane. The findings from this study can be applied in the design of a motor control system for overhead cranes, which will enhance safety and reduce maintenance and repair expenses.

articleTitle: Development Prospects of Small Hydroelectric Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article analyzed the structure of operating costs of Small Hydroelectric Power Plants (SHPP) facilities in Russia and abroad, and identified the main cost dependencies (on the capacity of the facility, the layout of structures, the organization of operation, etc.). The basic equipment used at the Small Hydroelectric Power Plants, it's main characteristics and manufacturing companies were identified. The analysis of the implemented projects (and projects in the active stage of implementation) of the organization of small hydroelectric power plants in Russia and abroad is carried out. The analysis of processes and operations during the creation and operation of the SHPP was carried out, key technologies for reducing the labor costs of operational personnel and trends in their development (in terms of organizational, technological and digital solutions) were identified.
