All these studies are aimed at the possibility of developing a concept for the unmanned operation of HSPP facilities and to identify measures that, in terms of efficiency criteria and readiness for implementation, can be taken to reduce the number of maintenance personnel.

articleTitle: Research and Optimization of an Electromagnetic Disc Friction Clutch
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Reviewing and performing a series of optimization engineering calculations of an electromagnetic disc friction clutch (electromagnetic, thermal, mechanical) to obtain the required operating mode. Verification electromagnetic, thermal and mechanical calculations of the basic version of the coupling were carried out. For a series of electromagnetic calculations, the finite element method was used to determine the optimal thickness and grade of the magnetic system, winding parameters; thermal and mechanical calculations of the optimal coupling design, calculations were performed in ANSYS software in 2D and 3D. During the optimization calculations of the electromagnetic friction clutch, the necessary geometry of the magnetic system and winding was selected, providing the required electromagnetic force and torque.

articleTitle: Development of a Mathematical Model of an Air Purification System for Industrial Premises Based on a Wet Single-Zone Electrostatic Precipitator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The problem of air pollution in industrial premises is considered. It seriously affects the health of workers and the environment. To solve this problem, effective ventilation and air filtration systems are used. When designing such systems, it is necessary to take into account the volume and nature of the room, the level of pollution, the system performance and the cleaning efficiency. A mathematical model has been developed that allows calculating the parameters of the room air cleaning system, taking into account the features of the room. A diagram and description of a wet single-zone electrostatic precipitator is presented, which is a promising device for air purification due to its high efficiency, continuous regeneration and low resistance to air flow. Its design requires a mathematical model that takes into account the influence of design and technological parameters on the operation of the device. A mathematical model of a wet single-zone electrostatic precipitator has been developed, which allows optimizing its design parameters to achieve maximum cleaning efficiency. When comparing experimental and calculated data on the efficiency of air purification by an electrostatic precipitator, it was found that the discrepancies are no more than 5%, which confirms the high accuracy of the model and its practical value for the design and improvement of electrostatic precipitators.

articleTitle: The Control System of Group Synchronous Generators with Different Power
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article focuses on interaction of several electricity sources combined into a microgrid. The article shows scheme of autonomous power supply based on a several permanent magnets synchronous generators. A feature of the scheme is the different nature of the rotors rotation. The authors, based on already known studies, note the possible occurrence of problems and tasks. The distribution of currents between the converter modules is the main problem due to the uneven power generated. This problem arises due to the difference in the speed of rotation of the generators. The authors propose to solve this problem using an control system algorithm based on comparing the actual current value at the output of the permanent magnets synchronous generators with the average current value on the DC bus. The created simulation model in MATLAB environment with Simulink extension package is considered. The model allowed to research of transient processes. The results of investigation of the simulation model when changing rotation speed of the generator drive shaft are given.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Findings of the Study of the Time to Saturation of Current Transformer Magnetic Circuits Located at Electric Power Facilities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Emergencies associated with incorrect operation of relay protection and automation (RPA) devices due to saturation of current transformers (CTs) can lead to great economic damage. The article presents an analysis of regulatory and technical documentation containing requirements for the quality of CT functioning in transient modes, statistical data on the results of calculations performed in accordance with the requirements of GOST R 58869–2019, as well as an analysis of the correctness of the assumptions introduced by it. To calculate the time to CTs saturation a special program was developed that automates the calculation methods, taking into account the assumptions focused on performing the manual calculations. The program takes into account the variation of the short circuit switching angle, the phase difference of the short circuit currents flowing through the branches feeding the short circuit point, the calculation of all CTs of a three-phase group with automatic selection of the worst result. The results obtained allow us to conclude about the relative number of CTs that do not meet the requirements of GOST R 58869–2019, the need to modernize existing methods and possible directions for such modernization. In addition, the article provides recommendations on the creation of automatic specialized software systems that can be used in the work of design, operating and research entities when they calculate the time to saturation of the CT magnetic circuits.

articleTitle: Reserves of Turbine Generator of Power Unit for Compensation of Magnetization Power of Unit Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The impact of increasing geoinduced currents on the mode of reactive power output of the “turbine generator (turbogenerator) - unit transformer” power unit of a thermal power plant into an adjacent electrical grid has been studied. The authors show that the main harmonic of the magnetization current of a unit transformer is in charge of overloading the turbogenerator with reactive power. The dependences of the reactive power of the turbogenerator of the power unit at different active loads and the setpoint of the automatic voltage excitation controller are defined; it makes it possible to estimate the turbine generator reserves for compensating the magnetization power of the unit transformer when the magnetic system is saturated. The quantitative estimates of the reactive power reserve have been obtained using the example of the TVV-320 turbogenerator to compensate for the magnetization power of a unit transformer with increased geomagnetic activity. It is shown that it is possible to additionally increase the reactive power of the turbogenerator by correcting the setpoint of the automatic voltage excitation controller and unloading the turbogenerator by active power. It is concluded that the stator current overload of the turbogenerator is possible during increased geomagnetic activity, which can result in the activation of the maximum current protection of the power unit “unit turbogenerator - unit transformer” for the disconnection and disruption of the stability of the adjacent electrical grid.

articleTitle: Analysis of Improved Ladle Furnace's Electrical Modes Automatic Control System in the Conditions of Real Production
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article considers the optimisation problem of electrical modes of two-stage ladle-furnace units and suggests the ways of their solution on the basis of improved control systems. The structure of facilities and electrical mode control systems functioning on them are analysed on the example of the units operated in electric steelmaking shops of domestic ferrous metallurgy enterprises. The automatic control algorithms of electrical modes for twin LFs are developed with full adaptation to each position. Two variants of the algorithms are presented: with and without adaptation to the emergency lance blowdown modes. The effectiveness of the developed solutions is demonstrated on the example of two units with identical technical characteristics. The operating principles of the algorithms are illustrated by oscillograms obtained from the operating units, where the experimental operation was carried out. The work results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed solutions, as well as their adaptation possibility for similar units.

articleTitle: Verifying the Results of Thin Dielectric Plate Analysis Using Mom-SIE with Approximate Integral Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The problem of analyzing the scattering properties of dielectric structures is always a difficult task due to its complexity. Many different modelling techniques have emerged to solve this problem, one of which is the use of the method of moments combined with the surface integral equation to analyze homogeneous dielectric structures. Such analysis is considered in this paper. We proposed the use of the method of moments and the surface integral equation with approximate integral solution instead of the direct one. The formulas derived here for such analysis are described and a MATLAB computer code based on them is developed to analyze thin dielectric plate excited by a TE-polarized plane wave. The results of the analysis of dielectric plates excited by plane waves with TM and TE polarization obtained using the developed code are verified by comparison with numerical results obtained in other publications. The good agreement between the compared results proved the efficiency of the developed code and also confirmed the correctness of using surface integral equation and the method of moments with approximate integral solution for analyzing homogeneous dielectric structures.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Vector Drive Control System with Two-Zone Regulation in Relative Units
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper presents an asynchronous electric drive control system, which can be installed in electric cars and electric locomotives. The paper describes signal transducers for an asynchronous vector drive control system that ensure two-zone shaft speed control, providing field weakening in accordance with a power and voltage limiting strategy. Attention is paid to reducing the control system to relative units, which makes it possible to adapt the program of the control microcontroller to a new motor and to a frequency converter by determining only the machine and sensor technical-and-operation data, but not the parameters of the regulators. These parameters only require tuning, depending on the noise level in a specific technical solution.

articleTitle: A Brushless DC Electric Motor with Direct Torque Control Technique Without Flux Linkage Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper introduces a brushless direct current (BLDC) motor with direct torque control without flux linkage control, utilizing hall effect sensors for rotor position detection and a specific magnetic system configuration. Such a magnetic system does not require flux linkage control for direct torque control. To eliminate current pulsations during phase commutations, algorithm of direct torque control of the BLDC motor is presented. Several simulations are performed using MATLAB/Simulink to examine the performance of the proposed system. The simulation shows that the electromagnetic output torque signal of BLDC motor has no pulsating at low speeds level up to 2700 RPM.

articleTitle: Methodology for Early Prediction of Single-Phase Ground Faults in Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article presents the results of the development of a methodology for forecasting single-phase ground faults in medium-voltage overhead lines, based on the analysis of emergency events that occurred in the Kaliningrad region from 2018 to 2023. The statistical studies carried out made it possible to estimate the number of different types of faults in the distribution network, as well as to group all occurred cases according to their development scenarios. A correlation between weather conditions in various combinations and the probability of single-phase ground faults occurring has been identified. To predict systematic faults, it is proposed to use the identified relationship between the occurrence of a neutral point displacement and the subsequent single-phase ground fault (SPGF). Previously, this parameter of the electrical network mode was not considered for prediction of single-phase faults. To determine the level of single-phase ground fault current, it is proposed to use the relationship identified in the study between the zero-sequence current in the previous neutral displacement mode and the single-phase ground fault current. Unlike existing prediction methods in distribution networks, the proposed method is based on a comprehensive analysis of possible causes of faults. It covers both systematic faults, which can be predicted by monitoring the electrical parameters of the electrical network, and non-systematic faults caused by external factors.

articleTitle: Impact of Routing on EMI Resilience in High-Speed Digital PCBs: A Time-Domain Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper investigates the electromagnetic interference (EMI) resilience of various microstrip transmission line (MSL) routing schemes commonly used in high-speed digital applications. The study focuses on minimizing crosstalk and enhancing signal integrity by optimizing the geometry and coupling between conductors. Traditional routing methods like meander and spiral configurations are compared against a novel scheme characterized by increased spacing between conductor turns. This proposed scheme allows for component placement beneath the transmission lines, potentially reducing overall printed circuit board (PCB) size. Quasi-static simulations are conducted using the TALGAT environment to evaluate the time-domain response of the different routing schemes to a Gaussian pulse excitation with frequencies ranging from 0 to 6 GHz. N-norms are employed to quantify the pulse characteristics and assess their potential impact on circuit performance and reliability. The results demonstrate that the meander configuration exhibits the lowest level of crosstalk, while spiral configurations show higher crosstalk, especially at high trace densities. Increasing the spacing between conductor turns in the proposed scheme effectively reduces crosstalk and enables modal decomposition, leading to a more desirable signal response.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Stability of Synchronous Motors During Three-Phase Voltage Dips Based on Mathematical and Simulation Models of Power Supply Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article presents the results of research on the characteristics of voltage dips occurring in external power supply systems of 110–220 kV due to three-phase short circuits. The studies conducted showed that the residual voltage during short circuits contains a decaying aperiodic component. This work details the investigation into the magnitude and duration of the aperiodic component of the transient process during short circuits in external power supply systems. The obtained results formed the basis for mathematical and simulation models of power supply systems at load nodes with synchronous motors during voltage dips caused by three-phase short circuits in the external network. The simulation model of the synchronous motor STD-8000 with a thyristor excitation system includes the main functional elements of the TE-320 excitation systems, including the connection of the starting resistor in parallel with the excitation winding during disturbances from the power supply, which corresponds to the operational features of the TE-320 excitation system. Studies conducted on the constructed models of the power supply system and synchronous motor demonstrated the influence of the aperiodic voltage component on the current in the excitation winding and the electromagnetic torque of the motor during voltage dips. It was found that the presence of the aperiodic component reduces the allowable duration of power interruption during which the synchronization of the synchronous motor with the network is not disrupted.

articleTitle: Crane Movement Modulator for Web Application of Electric Steel Melting Shop Mnemonic Scheme with Crane Movement Visualisation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper proposes a method of modulating crane movement in electric steel melting shop for web application of electric steel melting shop mnemonic scheme with the system of visualisation of cranes and steel ladles movement. The relevance of mnemonic scheme creation is caused by the problem of low transparency of cranes operation for the dispatcher, leading to downtime at the units and corresponding violations of steel production technology. Modulator is a Django application developed using noSQL DBMS Redis. With the help of the crane motion modulator, developers have an opportunity to debug the work in the web application without the need to install hardware at the stage of construction and testing of the web application. The file structure and web page of the modulator, the structure of JSON data passed to Redis are presented. This approach allows to increase the transparency and efficiency of crane operation, to increase the speed of decision making on the management of production operations in the shop floor within the shift.

articleTitle: Magnetomotive Force and Winding Coefficients of Alternating Current Windings
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The physical nature of the magnetomotive force (MMF) of an alternating current winding, discretely located in slots and being a source of a magnetic field that has both potential and vortex components, the latter being limited in the space of the slot, is considered. It is shown that in this capacity the role of the MDS is played by a set of magnetic sheets of slot currents, which, in terms of location and duration of sections with linear and nonlinear changes, can differ significantly from the generally accepted (classical) MDS winding. An analytical description of the stepped classical MMF curve of a winding with an integer and a fraction is proposed in the form of a set of expansions into a trigonometric series of MMF curves of coils, presented in the form of two-pole rectangles, having different heights and bases with a shortened winding pitch. It is shown that the frequency response of a fractional winding can be used to find the spectrum of its distribution coefficients for a known arrangement of coils in the slots. It was found using the example of a fairly simple fractional winding with a fractional denominator equal to 2 that, firstly, determining the spectrum of distribution coefficients using a well-known formula for windings with an integer by replacing this number with some equivalent one can lead to significant errors; secondly, variation in the winding pitch significantly changes the amplitudes of the higher harmonics of the MMF, including the appearance of harmonics with an order that is a multiple of three.

articleTitle: Considering the Quality of Electrical Energy of Organizations and Institutions' Electrical Complexes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The main distribution board of an office building is considered, for which monitoring of electrical energy quality parameters was carried out for twelve days and an analysis of the results obtained is presented. A classification of nonlinear consumers with a voltage of 380V is given. The coefficients of non-sinusoidality and n-th harmonic distortion of phase-to-phase voltages were determined for the building's distribution board section. A method for calculating the economic effect of quality failure of electrical energy is proposed. Based on the results of computational studies, the requirements for filter-compensating devices were determined.

articleTitle: Simulation of Snowmobiles - Small Electric Vehicles with a Track
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Since electric transportation is greener and less harmful to the environment, there is currently a growing interest in its development. The university racing team “Formula Student” has been developing the design and implementing a prototype of a small electric vehicle with a caterpillar track - a snowmobile. The primary goal is to attain maximum speeds while expanding the travel range. This article presents the state-of-development for electric and hybrid snowmobiles. We have simulated and analyzed the power traction system of electric snowmobiles. The resulting simulation model, under certain assumptions, allows to study electric and electromechanical processes in the all-electric snowmobiles. The results and driving characteristics obtained from simulation can be used to evaluate and design electric snowmobiles when fine-tuning its prototype.

articleTitle: Recommendations on Modeling Wire Grid Horn Structures for Sparse Antenna Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Based on method of moments, various wire grid antennas can be designed, which significantly reduce the antenna mass compared to solid metal structures. To meet the increasing demands for reducing the mass and size of antennas, the Optimal Current Grid Approximation approach was recently proposed. It can be applied to wire grid antenna structures to create their sparse versiones. Previous recommendations for the design of wire grid antenna structures are not adequate and suitable for the design of wire grid antenna structures that can be used to generate sparse antennas. In this paper, new recommendations for modeling the original wire-grid horn antenna are proposed and described in detail. The suitability and unsuitability of the previous recommendations are analyzed and the need for the new recommendations is justified. The effectiveness of the developed design guide was verified on the example of various horn antennas operating at UHF, X and K/Ka bands. The antenna characteristics of the wire grid structures designed using the new recommendations were compared with those calculated in different systems using other numerical methods, as well as with experimental results. The results of this paper enable antenna designers to quickly and accurately generate original horn wire grid structures with acceptable characteristics for sparse antenna applications.

articleTitle: An Improved Single-Phase Monopolar Generator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article describes the study of an improved design of a single-phase monopolar generator. The main difference of the design is the symmetrical EMF of the coils, with alternating polarity and low THD of the half-wave shape. The phase shift of 180° in the armature winding coils ensures optimal use of their EMF and efficiency. This design can be used in single-phase power supplies for the private use, low-power wind turbines and in some industrial applications. The design's stator fill factor (StatorEmbrace) is 0.3, which is slightly less than the stator fill factor of 0.375 of the three-phase design that the authors of the article proposed in the previous article. The design of the single phase generator is simple, and the achieved power level allows its practical application. The studied operating modes are presented in a reader-friendly form and can be used to assess the quality of design.

articleTitle: The Effect of the Load Factor of a Power Transformer and Asymmetric Phase Loads on Power Losses and Electrical Safety in a 380V TN-C Type Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article discusses the most commonly used types of 380 V artificial grounding systems for powering household electric consumers, as well as their advantages and disadvantages. Issues of the current state of power quality. The existing regulatory framework related to the quality of electricity is considered. Possible hardware methods for improving the quality of electricity, as well as the principle of their operation. A model of the electric network on which the studies were carried out, as well as the results on them, are given. The relationship between the asymmetry of single-phase loads, active power losses depending on the value of the transformer load and the values of asymmetrical single-phase electrical loads is shown, as well as some aspects related to electrical safety and electrical injuries of consumers during the operation of single-phase electrical appliances in the 380V power supply system of TN -C type are considered.

articleTitle: Multi-Chamber Ultra-High Frequency - Convective Drying Plant for Grain Cereals
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Modern grain drying complexes should ensure high-quality drying of food, seed and feed grains to preserve and improve its parameters. Each type of grain has its own limitations on the permissible level of damage to the grain. Therefore, modes with different intensity of mechanical action and rate of moisture removal are used to dry each of them. And the grain drying unit is precisely the device by which moisture is removed from the grain masses. The basic principle of heat supply in modern grain dryers is convective, all other options, if they exist, are more as experimental samples. According to the type of heating of the drying agent, convective grain dryers can be divided into devices with direct and indirect heating. In the first case, the air is mixed directly in the furnace with the combustion products and fed into the drying compartments, this is the most cost-effective method, but it is not recommended when removing moisture from food grains. When drying, indirect heating is used, that is, an intermediate heat exchange link is used in the form of a special radiator. In this scientific article, the scheme of the developed multi-chamber combined convective drying plant based on electromagnetic technology using a stepwise mode of an ultrahigh frequency electromagnetic field is considered.

articleTitle: Automatic System for Indirect Assessment of Gas Flow in Gas Collection Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Gas collection systems are used to collect gas from wells and transport it to complex gas treatment plants. These are flowlines connected to a valve station (VS) directly or via a com-mon collector. Gas moves down flowlines due to its own pressure. Since wells are united in clusters using the same flowline, their operational efficiency depends, among other things, on the mutu-al influence. Therefore, their capacities and flow rates in flow-lines need to be assessed at least approximately. Wells only feature pressure and temperature sensors that make up gas well telemetry systems. Wells are not fitted with flow meters. This article presents an algorithm for the indirect assessment of gas flow in flow lines based on the results of pressure and temperature measurements at the well mouth and the VS input. It is used as the base for the automatic system within the existing APCS and it facilitates flow rate assessment in real-time with an error of up to 4.2%, which is acceptable for the operative control of the gas collection system.

articleTitle: Optical Fiber Application for Temperature Monitoring of Cable Line State of Power Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article considers the possibility of measuring the temperature of cable transmission lines with the help of specially manufactured narrowed quartz optical fiber. The study of technological processes of manufacturing of narrowed fibers with stable repeatability of parameters at their heating with a short non-adiabatic region of contraction is carried out. The device of laboratory installation for revealing the expansion of optical fiber under the influence of temperature is considered. The influence of temperature on the laser beam deflection in the created quartz single-mode fiber is investigated. Using the considered technology, fiber optic sensors not only for temperature but also for other physical quantities such as refractive index, vibration, and electric field can be fabricated for use as sensing elements.

articleTitle: Dynamic State Estimation of Wind Power Plant Equipped with Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The problem of real-time monitoring of a grid-connected synchronous generator can be solved using state estimation methods. Static and dynamic state estimation methods are currently being developed. All state estimation methods provide information about the object in question using noisy measurements. In conditions where the operating states of the considered object change frequently and quickly the estimates of the dynamic state are needed. Real-time estimation of the dynamic state of a synchronous generator is possible when high-speed measurements and a correct dynamic model of the synchronous generator are available. This study aims to develop an algorithm of dynamic state estimation of a wind farm equipped with a synchronous generator. The dynamic model of the synchronous generator is presented by a d-q axis model. The d-q axis stator voltage and current are selected as a state vector. The values of the latter and the stator active and reactive power are used as measurements.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of the Possibilities of Ensuring the Accuracy of Robotic Marking of Workpieces of Complex Shapes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The work is devoted to an experimental study of options for implementing robotic marking of workpieces of complex shapes, in particular, to the issues of ensuring the required accuracy. An analysis of the features of marking technology has been carried out, basic information about the materials and marking methods used today is provided. The prospects for applying markings using robotic complexes instead of manual labor and the use of CNC machines are substantiated. Two experiments were carried out to test the possibility of ensuring the required accuracy of marking - one option using the built-in capabilities of the robot control system and the second option using an external measuring system. An experiment using the built-in capabilities of the robot control system showed that without additional tools it is impossible to ensure the required accuracy of marking. The second experiment showed that the use of a laser tracker as an external measuring system with correction of the robot's control program makes it possible to increase the accuracy of marking until the required results are achieved.

articleTitle: Modification of the Sugar-James Algorithm for Clustering Measurements of Mode Parameters
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper proposes the modified Sugar-James algorithm for identifying the number of clusters in measurements of mode parameters. This algorithm is based on the maximization of jumps of transformed intra cluster dispersion due to setting the dependence of the transformation degree from the number of clusters. The number of clusters selection is performed by an analysis of transformation degree dependence from the number of clusters. The dependence provides a maximum jump of transformed distortions. The results of the testing the algorithm by test measurements, following the normal distribution law are given, as well as comparison with the results of the Sugar-James algorithm other versions, where a constant value or a value, inversely proportional to the number of clusters, is given as the transformation degree. The modified algorithm is tested by real measurements of power mode parameters at load node. The results of the testing and verification by real measurements show the correctness of the number of clusters identification, and, also, the ability to identify the electrical load states.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Control Quality of Elastic Electromechanical System Using Various Correction Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Electromechanical systems that provide specified trajectories of movement of actuators are widely used in various industries. The requirements to reduce the mass and dimensional indicators of the elements of electromechanical systems, as well as to ensure fast performance lead to the fact that the quality of system functioning is significantly affected by elastic bonds. In the elastic system, there are oscillations of regulated coordinates, causing increased wear of elements, reduction of reliability, productivity and quality of functioning of production mechanisms. Synthesizing correction algorithms that provide specified quality indicators of the dynamic characteristics of electromechanical systems with elastic bonds is relevant and important task. This article studies the dynamic modes of an elastic electromechanical system with a modal controller and a second-order gradient control algorithm. Detailed modeling of the corrected systems taking into account coordinate and parametric perturbations is carried out. The results of comparative analysis of these correction methods in qualitative and quantitative terms are presented. The advantages and disadvantages of the mentioned correction algorithms are formulated and recommendations for their application are given.

articleTitle: Network Model for Parametric Synthesis of Resonant-Tunnel Heterostructure
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The resonant-tunnel diode is a promising element for application in various radio-electronic systems, which is due to the possibility of searching for the optimal combination of electrical characteristics of the resonant-tunnel structure and its design and technological parameters at the design stage. The results of solving the problem of parametric synthesis of the resonant-tunnel structure are presented. To reduce the iteration process of synthesis it is necessary to use a fast-acting model of current transfer, for this purpose a model based on an artificial neural network is used. To train the neural network model, the results of numerical simulation were used. In order to improve the accuracy of the neural network model, an ensemble method (bagging) of machine learning was used. The use of the model based on neural networks allowed us to achieve high accuracy and speed required for parametric synthesis of the resonant-tunnel structure.

articleTitle: Optimization the Parameters of Structures with Increased Ratio Modal Reservation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper considers the method of increasing the reliability and interference protection of radio-electronic devices through the use of modal reservation of circuits. As an increased ratio of modal reservation, we describe the 5- and 7-fold modal reservation based on 6- and 8-conductor reflection symmetric structures. These structures undergo parametric optimisation according to the criteria of minimisation of the output interference amplitude to increase the attenuation of the interference pulse, and minimisation of the squares of the difference between the maximum and minimum values of the time intervals to achieve their alignment. These structures allow the interfering UWB pulse to be attenuated by 4 times with reference to half of the EMF. In addition, we evaluate whether the multiplicity of interference attenuation can be equal to the multiplicity of modal reservation when the pulse is decomposed by the same number of times.

articleTitle: Increasing the Reliability of Automation and Telemechanic Field Devices at Railway Stations and Digitalizing the Service Provision Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: It is required to increase the capacity of the railway sections and ensure the safety of train movement, digitalization of highly efficient and reliable technical means, including the method of servicing the railway automation and telemechanics field devices, and the return of the database of the obtained results. Digitization of the methods of servicing automation and telemechanics field devices on railway sections allows increasing the safety of train movement, shortens the duration of individual operations and the time spent on service by electromechanics, and increases the labor productivity of workers. To ensure traffic safety at railway stations around the world, control and monitoring devices consisting of microprocessor elements are used to measure the parameters of the field devices of the station, station and intersection. Also, work is being done on remote monitoring of the processes of measuring the parameters of the control and control devices in the sections for the driver and dispatcher control, and the development of universal microprocessor-modulated electrical circuits for the management and control of these systems, and the creation of improved and improved software for modern microcontrollers.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Implementation of a Modified Method for Calculating Symmetrical Components Based on Synchronous Measurements of Instantaneous Currents in Three Phases in Operating Power Supply Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The trend of increasing the number and installed capacity of single-phase non-linear power consumers leads to deteriorated power quality. Unbalance in zero and negative sequences is a criterion for assessing the power quality. Moreover, the zero sequence unbalance factor is determined by the zero sequence current magnitude. The study is aimed at empirically justifying the advantages of implementing a method based on measuring the instantaneous currents synchronously in three phases over a single period to evaluate the zero sequence unbalance factor compared to the symmetrical component method using the phase factor for a more accurate assessment of current and voltage unbalance in distribution power grids. To achieve this goal, a test bench and a computer model of the power supply system were developed and built. The developed bench and computer model allowed for obtaining an array of synchronously measured instantaneous currents and voltages for each phase and in the neutral conductor with non-sinusoidal load magnitude andtypevarying independently for each phase. Thereat, the criterion for assessing the accuracy of calculating the zero sequence unbalance factor was the magnitude of the current in the neutral conductor. The use of the symmetrical component method for determining the zero sequence current in the case of amplitude-phase unbalance with active and inductive sinusoidal and non-sinusoidal loads givesan unacceptable error. To reduce errors in calculating the zero sequence current, the implementation of a method based on measuring the instantaneous currents synchronously in three phases over a single period is advisable.

Author Keywords: method for assessing symmetrical components by instantaneous currents

articleTitle: Development of Recommendations for Changing Power Quality Standards Taking Into Account the Experience of Operating Frequency Converters with Active Rectifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: To date, due to the appearance of high-power semiconductor converters using the principles of pulse-width modulation at production sites, the question arises about the relevance of the existing international standards regulating the electrical energy quality in the networks of industrial enterprises. In particular, frequency converters with active rectifiers as part of the main electric drives of rolling mills are widely spread. The operation experience of such electric drives has shown a high probability of voltage distortion of supply network of average voltage 6–35 kV over the permissible level by harmonics of high order, with numbers higher than 40–50. These voltage distortions arise due to high order current harmonics, generated by frequency converters with active rectifiers, on high impedance sections of the network frequency response, when even a small in amplitude high frequency current flows. The presence of high impedance sections in the frequency response of the 6–35 kV network is explained by the parallel resonance between the network transformer inductance and the equivalent capacitance of the cable lines leaving the substation. Modern power quality standards applied in the CIS, EU, and North America regulate the content of harmonics up to 40–50, which makes it difficult to assess the impact of high-power semiconductor converters on the voltage quality in the supply network. Therefore, the urgent task is to develop recommendations for changing the existing power quality standards, taking into account the experience of practical operation of frequency converters with high-power active rectifiers.

articleTitle: Digital Simulation of a Magnetohydrodinamic Pump for Mixing Aluminium Melt During Recycling
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Aluminum production is constantly expanding. The primary production of aluminum from natural minerals is associated with high energy and economic costs, while aluminum can be remelted almost an infinite number of times. Depending on the volume, the different layers of the melt have different temperatures and different densities. When such a melt solidifies, its crystal lattice is disrupted and the properties of the material deteriorate. For this reason it is necessary to mix the molten mass in one of the known methods. These methods should be simple, reliable and economical. The purpose of the study: to propose a cost-effective method for mixing the melt with minimal reconstruction of existing furnaces and applied remelting technologies. Methods: it is proposed to use combining mechanical mixing and the use of electromagnetic forces to pump the melt from one part of the bath to another. An induction magnetohydrodynamic alternating current pump is used to implement the method. The concept has been tested on a digital model implemented in the Ansys Electronics Desktop software package. Results: The obtained characteristics confirmed the operability of the device and the required amount of developed force on the melt. The digital model was used as the basis for creating a three-dimensional solid-state design model in the Compass graphics environment. The article describes the design of the device and its layout in the tray of the melting furnace. Practical significance: a simple, reliable and cheap method of mixing aluminum melt during its recycling has been developed.

articleTitle: Application of Self-Regulated Permanent Magnet Eddy-Current Brakes for Improvement of Dynamic Stability of Distributed Generation Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The applications and usage of small power plants is growing, so the challenge is to ensure the reliability of distribution networks with distributed hybrid generation. This paper describes a method for ensuring stability by creating additional braking torque on the shaft of synchronous generators during faults. The application of a permanent magnet eddy-current brakes with a self-regulating torque (PMECB), which can be used to improve the dynamic stability of power systems, is considered. Torque control is achieved by changing the configuration of the magnetic circuit or the conducting rotor. The possibility of using a self-regulated PMECB to ensure the dynamic stability of synchronous generators is analyzed. The constructed simplified model shows the possibility of using a self-regulating brake with permanent magnets to brake the rotor of a synchronous generator during power drops.

articleTitle: Triangular Trihedral Corner Reflector Analysis Using Wire-Grid and MoM with Pulse Basis Functions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The problem of analyzing the scattering characteristics of corner reflecting structures in general and the triangular trihedral corner reflector in particular always attracts attention because of its many practical applications. The method of moments is used in such analysis due to the simplicity of its algorithm and low computational cost. Therefore, in this paper, a comparative investigation is carried out in this paper using the wire grid approach that based on the method of moments with pulse basis functions for analyzing the scattering characteristics of triangular trihedral corner reflectors. The accuracy of the obtained results is evaluated by a comprehensive comparison with calculated and measured results from earlier publications. The efficiency of using this technique for analyzing complex scattering structures is verified by the good agreement of the compared results.

articleTitle: Optimisation of Flexible Printed Cable with Broad Side and Edge Coupling and Alternating Arrangement of Signal and Reference Conductors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Ultra-wideband (UWB) pulse interference causes radio electronic devices (RED) to malfunction. To protect against such interference, modal filtering technology is proposed. Modal filters can be implemented at different structural levels (in the form of cables, as separate protective devices and in printed circuit boards). This allows the amplitude of UWB interference to be minimised. In addition, they can be implemented in flexible printed cables (FPCs), which have been widely used in various REDs in recent years. In this paper, we have optimised a flexible printed cable with broad side and edge coupling and alternating arrangement of signal and reference conductors. The investigation was carried out with real parameters of single-sided polyimide with a total thickness of 80 µm. We performed optimisation according to three criteria: minimisation of pulse amplitudes, maximisation of the per-unit-length mode delay difference and matching with a 50 Ω path. We have shown how the thickness of the radio-absorbing material, the distance between the conductors and their width affect the amplitude of the decomposition pulses and the difference of the per-unit-length mode delays. Thus, the optimisation allowed to achieve 17 times (Umax=0.054 V) attenuation of the UWB interference with respect to half e.m.f. This investigation shows that it is possible to attenuate dangerous electromagnetic interference in FPC with front and side connections and alternate arrangement of signal and support conductors without using additional protection devices.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Efficiency of Using Non-Conductive Composite Brushes for Cleaning Collectors and Current-Removing Rings of Electric Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article explores the possibility of effective maintenance of the sliding current collector unit (CCU) of electric machines (EM) by facilitating repair and preventive measures to prepare for operation of current collector rings and collectors. The authors propose to use non-conductive composite brushes based on talc powder to clean collectors and current-removing rings after routine operation or in case of technological deposits (“deposits”, inorganic and organic pollutants, etc.) from “improper” switching (increased spark level, circular fire, etc.). These brushes can be inserted into the socket of a free brush holder or fastened to a used standard brush in the form of a tip, followed by starting the engine (generator) at idle. The effectiveness of the measure was assessed visually and by the magnitude of the transient resistance of the sliding track. The effectiveness of this technique is shown on the copper collector MSHV2.230, the bronze collector of the generator GS-12TOK and the steel ring of the voltage converter PO-250 when installing these brushes on the sliding tracks brush-collector, brushring. The developed brushes are inexpensive to manufacture, have a high resource capacity and can act as an alternative to mass-produced grinding bars and stones. The authors have received priority for this type of product. To involve the development in the industry, the help of interested industrial partners is required.

articleTitle: Acoustic Positioning of Partial Discharges in High-Voltage Transformer Tank
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This report reviews an example of acoustic positioning of partial discharges (PD) in the tank of a high-voltage oil-filled transformer. The literature review confirms the importance of PD monitoring and justifies the feasibility of positioning discharge activity centers. The precise positioning of PD sources is required to determine the location of insulation defects. The authors provide brief information on the development of PD positioning methods and note that their practical application has been insufficiently covered in publications. They present the results of electromagnetic and acoustic PD positioning in a 110 kV transformer. Some details are provided on the devices and measurement methods used, including the localization of areas with increased PD intensity using one acoustic sensor and the subsequent center localization through the installation of 4 sensors at even intervals. The authors provide PD signals and defect impulses received from each of the sensors and demonstrate the difference in the registration time of these signals. They explain the principle behind PD center positioning, which is determined considering delays in signal reception. The authors demonstrate the usage of the Inva (Portable) software for the processing and visualization of acoustic positioning results. They note that changes in the propagation rate of acoustic waves in a heterogeneous medium result in the reduced accuracy of results. The authors also outline the prospects of the research into the elimination of occurring defects.

articleTitle: The Concept of a Diagnostic Stand for Validation of the Electronic Architecture of the Car
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article discusses the very important problem for the existing automotive industry of validating and assessing the performance of electrical equipment of a modern car, as well as a way to solve it by developing, creating and implementing the concept of a diagnostic stand for validating the electronic architecture of a car. After a theoretical and practical study of existing validation systems, comparing their advantages and disadvantages, a concept for a diagnostic stand was developed for subsequent implementation on the basis of existing production facilities. Requirements were also developed for the validation stand and for the various components that make it up and are included in a modern car. The result of the work carried out was a fully formed and described concept of a diagnostic stand for validating the electronic architecture of a car. Based on the available data and using this concept, it is planned to implement a stand for validating the electronic architecture of a car at existing industrial or scientific-industrial centers of the automotive industry to improve the overall quality of manufactured cars.

articleTitle: Increasing the Static Stability of Synchronous Generators with Group Excitation Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: A feature of industrial power plants is a significant change in their parameters under different loads, both in normal and emergency operation. Individual energy-intensive consumers can have a power commensurate with the power of synchronous generators and be connected at different electrical distances, including on the generator voltage buses. The purpose of these studies is to develop a set of measures to ensure the static stability of synchronous generators with group excitation control. To do this, based on an analysis of the operational parameters of normal and emergency modes of factory power plants, opportunities for increasing static stability were identified. First of all, this is the improvement of excitation and speed control systems for power supplies. This work is based on the principle of group excitation control to maintain the same value of rotor angles. An algorithm has been developed that makes it possible to estimate the static stability margin of synchronous machines in various operating modes during group regulation and parallel operation with the power system. It is also possible to change their parameters with specified restrictions. A software package has been obtained for calculating transient electromechanical processes of synchronous generators operating at a generalized load in normal and emergency modes. A computational experiment was carried out showing the influence of different loads of power plant turbogenerators on stability.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Requirements for Electrical Networks During the Transformation of a Boiler House into a Mini-CHP
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Due to the decrease in the efficiency of energy supply systems, which consists in increasing the cost of electricity, reducing accessibility and low reliability of power supply, the consumer is often forced to independently look for solutions to improve the efficiency of their power supply. At the same time, there is a tendency in Russia for total gasification of regions and affordable foreign and domestic low-power gas piston and gas turbine equipment. This has led to the growth of distributed energy and mini-CHP plants with a capacity of up to 25 MW. At the same time, one of the ways to create a mini-CHP is the reconstruction of gas heating boilers. This determines the tasks of analyzing the requirements for the power output schemes of such stations and identifying the requirements for the reconstruction of distribution electrical networks during the transformation of a boiler house into a mini-CHP.

articleTitle: Algorithms of Signal Processing in Traveling Wave Fault Location Complexes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The purpose of the work is to substantiate the possibility traveling wave fault location (TWFL) complex functioning in branched distribution networks of medium voltage class. Traveling waves (TW) are born in the place of fault. The complex registers the time of TW arrival to the ends of the network in a unified satellite time scale. Then the complex calculates the fault location. The main factor complicating the complex's functioning in branched networks of medium voltage class lines is the presence of a large number of concentrated inhomogeneities in the form of nodes with branches. Analytically and with the help of model calculations in PSCAD program, we can obtain TW transmission coefficient through inhomogeneity nodes at different types of faults. The paper shows the experiments' results. A large number of complex's sensors in several ends of the branched network allows us to determine the time TW registration and the speed of their propagation along the lines between paired combinations complex's sensors. Comparison of the registered propagation speed with the speed of light allows us to separate reliable or accurate registrations of the TW beginning from unreliable registrations. It is shown, that the amplitude of the registered TW and the amplitude of stationary and non-stationary noise at the place of registration determine the reliability of the complex operation. The paper compares the results of TW registration generated inside and outside the area controlled by the complex.

articleTitle: Instrument Survey of the Electricity Supply System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Instrumental survey of the power supply system is carried out to measure the actual load parameters at individual outgoing feedlines in agreement with the customer, as well as for the purpose of in-process monitoring of electric energy quality indicators, for their compliance with the requirements of GOST 32144–2013 “Electric energy. Electromagnetic compatibility of technical equipment. Power quality limits in the public power supply systems”. The article presents the results of in-process monitoring of electric energy quality indicators as compliant with the requirements of GOST 32144–2013 “Electric energy”; values of odd voltage harmonics not multiple of three; values of odd voltage harmonics divisible by three; values of total voltage harmonics; Conclusions on the results of in-process monitoring of electric energy quality indicators.

articleTitle: Hall Converters with Increased Noise Immunity for Information Collection, Measurement and Control of Electric Power Modes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The development of modern energy, consisting of energy sources with different generation principles, including large and limited capacity, requires a unified management system. At the same time, the distribution and transmission of energy to consumers is tightly linked to the production of electricity. Consumers of electricity affect the modes and quality of the electricity received. The integration of all links into a single system requires the mandatory synchronous collection and transmission of information into a single system. One of the important information elements are primary converters, on the accuracy and speed of which the stable and reliable operation of all energy facilities largely depends. Therefore, high requirements are placed on such a critical element as current sensors in terms of conversion accuracy, noise immunity and performance. In this paper, we solve the problems of designing current sensors based on universal current sensors based on Hall converters that meet the requirements of increased noise immunity to the currents of neighboring buses.

articleTitle: Experimental Determination of the Transformer Equivalent Circuit Parameters in the Electric Vehicle Charger DC/DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Over the past decade, the production of electric vehicles and charging stations for them has grown at a significant rate. Thus, if in 2014 less than half a million electric vehicles were produced worldwide, then in 2023 this number exceeded forty million. This trend has not bypassed Russia either - over the past six months, the number of fast charging stations has grown by 142%. However, when traveling long distances in the central and eastern parts of our country, electric vehicle enthusiasts are still forced to carefully plan their route. One possible solution to this problem is the use of portable fast chargers that allow to connect directly to switchboards. The disadvantage of such chargers is their fairly large weight and dimensions. This article discusses the design and operating principle of portable fast chargers. The greatest attention is paid to the DC/DC converter as part of the charger power module. The pulse transformer has the largest mass in the DC/DC converter for fast chargers. The mass and dimensions of the pulse transformer in the prototype of the fast charger were determined experimentally. The parameters of its electric equivalent circuit (active resistance and inductance of the primary and secondary windings) were found. The computer model, assembled in the Matlab Simulink program, confirmed the reliability of the obtained results. Also, based on the obtained data, the current density of the transformer windings was calculated. The found values are the initial ones for designing a pulse transformer with improved mass and size indicators based on a multifunctional integrated electromagnetic component.

articleTitle: The Effectiveness Evaluation of Automatic Voltage Level Control in the Traction Network of AC Railways
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The work evaluates the effectiveness of voltage level control in an AC traction power supply system. Using the SimInTech program, a dynamic model of the traction power supply system was developed. A model for automatic voltage control of a booster transformer based on a PID controller is proposed. A theoretical calculation of the energy-optimal voltage ratio of neighboring traction substations based on the superposition method is presented. The simulation results showed that controlling the voltage level leads to a significant improvement in the throughput and energy efficiency of the railway section. At the same time, the best results were demonstrated by the method based on stabilizing the voltage level in the middle of the intersubstation zone. The option, which focuses on equalizing the voltage at adjacent traction substations, ensures the most uniform loading of traction substations, but leads to a slight increase in electricity losses and does not guarantee the throughput of the railway section. Prospects for further development of the research topic are given.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Solving the Inverse Problem of Thermal Conductivity to Control the Heating of the Stator Winding of an Electric Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The problem of finding an algorithm for the numerical solution of the inverse problem of thermal conductivity, which is stable against temperature measurement errors, has been solved, which can be used as the basis for means of monitoring the temperature of the stator winding of an asynchronous motor. The problem was solved using the example of heating a low-voltage closed-type asynchronous motor, for which the technical data, dimensions and thermophysical parameters are known. The initial data for the inverse problem were the results of solving the direct heat conduction problem, solved using the finite element method using the PDE Toolbox Matlab software package. A new algorithm for solving the inverse heat conduction problem is obtained within the framework of difference methods. The results develop and complement previously performed studies and confirm the established theoretical possibility of estimating the temperature of the stator winding based on the results of measuring the temperature on the surface of the motor.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Savonius Rotor Performance with Guiding Nozzles Made of Solar Panels
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Wind and solar are complementary energy sources, so using both of those in a hybrid stand-alone power system ensures significant reduction of generators' nameplate and energy storage capacity. The possibilities of solar and wind components to improve each other's performance usually stay out of consideration, not impossible though. We suggested using vertical bifacial solar panels arrays to increase the wind cross-section area, those are not radial but inclined, so are guiding the flow at the optimal angle to the rotor and reducing the drag of the returning blade. Enhanced air flow reduces the temperature of solar panels. Shading by neighbor deflectors was minimized considering the overall effect on system output. We have simulated the airflow in such a system to see the effect of the suggested approach, which turned out to be rather impressive: in poor wind conditions we got the annual energy output yield of 205 and for good wind conditions of 28 compared to the classic Savonius rotor, and those were greater than 12-fold wind cross-section increase. We have also optimized the rotor shape according to the new airflow conditions, which also has given additional yield compared to the Savonius rotor. Our special rotors have shown better performance at low wind speeds with cut-in below 1 m/s. Thus, the suggested layout allows getting at poor wind conditions more energy from a single turbine than at good wind conditions without it.

articleTitle: Development of an Embedded Power Supply System for Thyristor Driver Powered from Cathode-Anode Voltage
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The high-power thyristors require reliable power supply for their drivers. The implementation of galvanic isolation for medium voltage applications needs large dielectric gaps and clearances which makes solutions bigger and more expensive. This paper proposes to use cathode-anode voltage variation for the thyristors operated in controlled rectifiers. The additional series capacitors circuit is used to implement power supply for the driver to control the gate voltage and current with respect to cathode electric potential. The functional diagram the power supply is provided and the method for evaluation of the circuit parameters was developed. The simulation model was built, and simulation result showed the feasibility of the proposed solution.

articleTitle: Hydroacoustic Complex for Studying the Condition of Underwater Engineering Communications of the Cable Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: There are numerous occasions where a cable network is laid along the bottom of a reservoir. It is essential to carry out an investigation for a bottom of reservoir prior to installing cable along its length. It is possible to explore the bottom of a reservoir in several ways: diving survey, photo-video filming and using sonar equipment. The use of sonar equipment has several advantages, including area survey and the ability to work in turbid water. It is also necessary to periodically examine the already laid cable to check for erosion, sagging, etc. defects. Such investigations are conducted not only to figure out the scope of accidents that occurred before, but also to prevent incidents. To perform this type of work on hydroacoustic survey of underwater utilities, multi-beam echo sounders or side-scan sonars paired with parametric pro filers are most applicable.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Characteristics of a Linear Rod Position Sensor of a Tracking Hydraulic Drive Based on Digital Modeling of the Electromagnetic State
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The development of tracking hydraulic drives for high forces, movements and frequencies of mechanical action on the tested products is an urgent task, since without these tests it is impossible to put products into serial production. The tracking hydraulic drive is a complex. One of the most important devices in the system is the linear displacement sensor of the hydraulic cylinder rod, which is located in the feedback circuit. The peculiarity of the sensor being developed is that it must provide high accuracy parameters. The purpose of the study is to determine the most effective design of the three most common ones based on digital modeling. Methods: The Ansys Electronics Desktop complex was chosen as a program for digital modeling, which allows modeling electromagnetic processes. The program allows you to create a digital duplicate of the sensor itself and the control system for it. Results: the main characteristics are determined on the digital model: the dependence of the output voltage and the nonlinearity of the output characteristic on the movement of the rod. According to the selected criteria, the best parameters were shown by a sensor with a radial arrangement of windings when placing the primary winding inside and the secondary measuring windings outside. Practical significance: the main practical result of the study is to reduce technical risks before mass production of the sensor. The created digital model is parameterized and can be used to study inductive sensors with other sizes and parameters

articleTitle: Challenges of AODV Protocol Under Excessive Load in the OMNeT++/INET Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper presents a case of a network overload when using a protocol that does not imply high-load operation. The simple, predictable and relatively reliable Ad Hoc On Demand Vector protocol (AODV) was chosen for the study as one of the popular basic protocols for self-organizing networks, used in Internet of Things and Internet of Everything as a current stage of Internet evolution and industrial automation. The testing was done in OMNeT++/INET environment. The simulation model was made of several nodes, positioned to organize two intersecting routes and a longer bypass route. The testing consisted of five different scenarios including a minimal and excessive load. The last scenario had an additional physical barrier between the routes, forcing the nodes to pick a bypass route. The test showed AODV working properly under minimal load and the routing failure under excessive load due to the protocol inability to reorganize transmission routes in response to the network load. The test also proved that the physical separation of the routes significantly decreased the packet loss, leading to several solutions for improving the network speed and reliability of AODV based networks.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Asymmetry of the Magnetic System of the Traction Switched Reluctance Motor of an Electric Train
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The use of a switched reluctance motor as a traction motor for high-speed electric train will improve the competitiveness of railway transport. When manufacturing a switched reluctance motor, it is quite difficult to achieve a uniform gap of a minimum value. The presence of an asymmetric air gap determines the conditions of one-way magnetic attraction forces. Bearings which are subjected to increased wear and tear are the place of application of forces. Cases of asymmetry of the magnetic system of a switched reluctance motor during dynamic rotor displacement are considered. Force studies under such displacement were carried out using the finite element method of the FEMM program. In advance, by means of the software complex MATLAB (SIMULINK), motor mode operating currents are determined. The analysis of the obtained results of the calculation of the forces of one-way magnetic attraction is conducted. In order to reduce or limit these forces to a certain acceptable level, a number of recommendations are given in the work. Measures are presented to increase the service life of a switched reluctance motor. They are carried out at stages of the life cycle of an electric machine, taking into account the presence of unevenness in the magnetic system.

articleTitle: Development of Methods and Conceptual Design Tools for Simulation of Trigeneration Systems on the Basis of Gas Turbine Engine
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Faster growth in consumption and limited sources of energy generation are two major challenges for sustainable energy systems in today's world. These issues have generated widespread interest in the study and development of new modern energy generation technologies. One of the most common technologies is a combined trigeneration system that simultaneously produces electricity, heat and cold. In trigeneration systems, gas piston or gas turbine engines are often used to generate electricity, and waste gases are used in the recovery cycle for heating with heat exchanger and cooling with thermally active equipment. Because of the simultaneous production of electricity, cooling and thermal energy from a single energy source, trigeneration systems can achieve higher fuel efficiency than conventional heat and power systems. In addition, since energy is generated near end users, trigeneration systems can improve the energy reliability of socially significant facilities for the population. The aim of the study is to increase the efficiency of trigeneration systems created on the basis of a gas turbine engine by developing methods and means for the modelling and design thereof. In this work CAE-system of conceptual modeling for the simulation of systems of trigeneration was developed and approbation of the developed CAE-system was done in the example of calculation of trigeneration installation on the basis of gas turbine engine.

articleTitle: Estimation of Economic Viability of Reactive Power Compensation on Gas Production Industry Facilities, Based on Energy Consumption Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The relevance of the study is driven by the presence of numerous reactive power consumers in the power supply systems of gas production industry facilities. However, in existing and dynamically developing power supply systems, it is difficult to assess the most probable operating modes of electrical equipment and there could be no data on its reactive power consumption. Installing reactive power compensation devices under such circumstances may not be economically viable. Therefore, the development of methodologies for determining the boundaries of the economic feasibility of power factor correction in conditions of uncertainty becomes a relevant task. The aim of the study is to determine the economically reasonable level of reactive power compensation for the power supply system of an operational industrial enterprise, taking into account electrical energy losses, network elements load, voltage level, and the cost of reactive power compensation measures, assuming that data on the reactive power factor of consumers is unavailable. The research object is the power supply system of gas production industry facilities. To achieve this goal, used methods of mathematical modeling, and linear optimization. Results and conclusions: Presented methodology for determining the economically feasible level of reactive power compensation in the absence of some initial data on power supply system consumers and their operating modes. Using this methodology, the power and installation location of compensating devices were determined based on data on active and reactive power consumption and the power supply system's topology, using the criterion of minimizing costs under real and maximum electrical load conditions.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Shipboard Microgrids Integrating Renewable Energy on Coastal Areas of Vietnam
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Green energy has recently received substantial attention and research in the maritime industry. Therefore, a new trend is integrating renewable energy sources (RESs) into the Shipboard Microgrid (SMG), which is increasingly applied. Some advantages include supporting the capacity of hotel loads and non-critical loads at peak hours. In addition, these energy sources are abundant, clean and renewable. However, these energy sources are affected by natural conditions, which will cause a decrease in power generation capacity. This paper presents constructing an SMG model with solar energy and fuel cells. At the same time, the impact of natural conditions on the SMG and their potential in the future should be analysed.

articleTitle: Development of a Time Series Forecasting Method Based on Entropy Measures of Diagnostic Information
publicationTitle: 2024 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The purpose of this work is to develop an approach to forecasting time series of diagnostic indicators of complex technical systems. The following problems were solved: a conceptual model of entropy time series was developed. Also, within the framework of the project, a methodology for forecasting time series was developed taking into account the constructed entropy time series. Entropy time series are constructed from time series from initial data by calculating a measure of entropy. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed models and algorithms, software was developed in C#. Experiments were conducted on more than 10 technical time series obtained from the Computational Intelligence in Forecasting (CIF) dataset using this software. Two sets of experiments were conducted: in the first experiment, 10 row points were predicted based on the training set. The effectiveness of the developed approach was just over 60%. In the second experiment, for each subsequent forecast point, all previous points in the series were used. The forecast accuracy exceeded 80%. As a comparison of the developed approach with experiments on CIF data showed, the result was good, but there are algorithms that showed better results - for example, a hybrid method of an exponential model and a fuzzy model. To improve the efficiency of algorithms in new works, we plan to vary approaches to granulating the original time series data. The article is intended for specialists involved in diagnosing technical systems.
